reviews.review_text: Love my 2022 Kia Telluride. Drives smooth with many innovative features. Comfy and stylish interior.
Love it so far; it is my favorite car that I have ever owned.
The KIA TELLURIDE looks good, drives well, and is a quality-built vehicle!

My Kia Telluride is so comfortable for my family of four plus my kids' friends. It's easy and fun to drive, and it's comfortable as a passenger on road trips. The cup holders and charging ports have been perfect. The Car Play feature has room to grow; Google Maps lags, and music and podcasts don't have the same features as they do from your phone, making it tricky to navigate while driving. The buttons for putting down the second-row seats have been so handy. And I love how the tailgate opens when I stand behind it without having to press any buttons; this is so helpful when my hands are full. The black interior shows every bit of dirt and dust, so if I could change anything about my car, that would be it. The front of the car has been hard to get used to because it sits up high and there are no sensors in the front to tell me when I'm close to something. The seat heaters and ventilation system have been perfect. Overall, I love how quiet the car is and how it blocks road noise. While yes, there are a couple of things I would change, I absolutely love my Telluride and don't regret our decision at all.
Great features, drives nicely, goes when you need it to and comfortable.
Recommended for the room on the inside for yourself and family without sacrificing comfort while maintaining a modern exterior.
Looks great. Drives great. Love all the features. This is a keeper.
2022 Kia Telluride. I needed third row seating. Drives great, looks great, has amazing features. Happy with it so far
Well made, quiet, good value, great warranty, good looks,

Think carefully about all of the features you have in your current car. There are basic features that are lacking in the Telluride that you most likely have and assume will be in your new car. They aren't. Other than that the Telluride is very quiet and smooth. I love driving it.
I love it!! I have gotten many compliments and have already recommended it to a few people.
If a problem occurs that requires service, especially parts, the length of time the car is out of commission could be lengthy.
For the MSRP offered on the Kia Telluride, you are getting a lot of car for less than other vehicles. Kia has come up big time with the brand and reputation. I love my car.
KIA makes a quality & reliable vehicle. Gas mileage is great. Easy to drive.

It's easy to drive, safe, reliable, fun and is a no-brainer if you have kids. I say this because of the safety rating and the fact that carseats fit so well and leave more leg room than any other car we tried.
Very affordable luxury. Exceptional quality, service and warranty.
The air conditioning for third row is terrible.

Overall I love it! Comfortable, good handling, and great looking car. Most luxurious and smoothest car with good power I have owned so far. Great warranty and so far worth the money. Car seems extremely reliable so far.
Great vehicle overall, and would like to see more advancements in Bluetooth connecting.
It is very comfortable, has great safety features, includes superior technologies, has a fantastic interior layout, an eye-catching exterior and is roomy.

reviews.review_text: Great looking sporty looking car. Dress it up it looks retro like the early 70's barracudas
I love the body style 2023 was the last year for this body make so it was perfect I got the v6 and that's all I needed
The paddle shifter manual mode option isn't as fun as I thought it would be. I prefer a regular manual transmission for such a sporty, true muscle car.
It is a ton of fun to drive. People love seeing it and trying to race it.

The carbon fiber package is great. Adaptive Cruise Control a must have. Get the technology package for a moisture sensing windshield wipers and auto high beams. I love the voice commands. The 6.4L Hemi is incredible and fun. Harmon Kardon stereo is really worth it. Plus package is worth it. Love the 6 piston brembo brakes. Sunroof option is worth it.
Old School charm with modern updates.
She's a thirsty girl and she only drinks the good stuff.
Good safe comfy car that's fun to drive
Best muscle car ever! Super happy!
I love my vehicle. The look, the comfort, excitement, and performance.
It's a nice comfortable car with looks and power.
You will enjoy your car immensely it drives perfectly, and I love mine to death
This car has style and performance from the 60's and 70's. Few cars made today can make that claim. It is a timepiece from the best of automobile history.
The vehicle is tough yet classy. I love driving my challenger as it gives me confidence yet I feel safe.
It is very fun to drive. Sounds awesome!
I bought a 2023 Shakedown Last Call edition - Black/wide body/manual trans and I love it. I don't drive much, but have a blast when I do.

This Challenger and the last 2 other Challengers have been bullet proof with no breakdowns or recalls while looking like a sports car plus the convenience of a muscle car. Just by looking at it you know it's going to be a collector car as a 2 door and well worth the money.
It is a sporty, fun to drive car that is well built and has the reliability of the Dodge brand.
I love the styling, power, sound, big car feel.
It is a good car and I would recommend it to anyone.

reviews.review_text: I love the ability to be able to fit adults in the back seats comfortably which helps a lot when you work in construction. The ability to drive off road as needed and knowing the truck can take some abuse and still run like a champ.
The 2020 GMC Sierra has been a blessing in disguise. No recalls, great power and it looks amazing on date night out.
Excellent use of technology for phone and devices. Love the seat warmers, keyless entry and tons of front passenger storage. The backup camera has great options for needed rv hookups.
Enjoy a full size pickup truck.
It gets great fuel economy and the truck is beautifully designed.
Pick up that feels like an luxury SUV.

The LM2 3.0 Duramax is a great little engine. It gets amazing mileage for such a large truck. The AT4 trim level on the Sierra has all the bells and whistles you would expect from a German luxury car and the Multi-Pro Tailgate gets used a surprising amount. Don't be discouraged by the dated interior design. You will get used to it, but this should get a refresh in 2022 as seen on the new Yukon/Tahoe and I would probably wait until then to fully recommend the car.
Excellent Truck.

The 1500 Sierra GMC is probably the best truck on the market in it's class.  This stands out with the engine compartment redesign utilizing the inline 6 diesel with new environmental technology as well as a turbo combining it with the 10 speed transmission. On-the-fly 4WD is awesome. The base options for the SLT was just enough to make the truck enjoyable, I felt the Denali package was over kill; this is still a truck. The AT version is for boys with toys.   The addition of the Rancho shocks makes the ride enjoyable and stiff while pulling a trailer.  It easily pulls a 28 foot trailer and there is little drag and bouncing going over bridges.  Noise cancellation with the carpet wheel base liners as well as the cab foam makes it a quite truck. The tail gate, best on the market. Minor irritation is the interior with regards to the sound system, a joke with little to no bass and only a three bar equalizer and moreover it has terrible interior lighting. The low power LED map light just does not do the job lighting up the cab and I have to use a flash light to see anything. The lighting exterior is great. The biggest concern is the strange noises, like hamsters, when the engine shuts off. This is the turbo actuator decompressing the pressure.  Understandable, but if the vehicle sits and a door is opened, things constantly move under the hood.  If sitting there for five minutes, after decompression, other things just turn on and makes noises. Not sure what it is trying to do. With all of these things happening when the engine is off, brings considerable concern with the longevity of the components. I would like to see some of the parts made in Mexico brought to the US. I see rusting of the bolts already on the under carriage. The interior design is common and far behind FORD and RAM. I think the 2021 models made it more competitive.
My truck does everything I need a truck to do. It looks and performs  great. It's overall the best truck I have ever owned.
Excellent overall experience. Would highly recommend.
Nice power for the engine size.

The truck is great, I am 6' 3" and it is easy to get into. I got the AT4 which has a little lift, my elderly grandfather was in the market for a new vehicle shortly after I got my truck so I recommended he get the Denali version of the Sierra 1500 due to its lower height. He is also very happy. I only have run into a small issue where the Sirius XM stops working if I stop for coffee and get back into the truck quickly afterward. I like the Multipro tailgate, it was a great idea... button placement not the best on the back of the tailgate. Also probably should offer a button to put the tailgate back up. My old f150 had a button in the truck bed that allowed me to turn the lights on, the only way to turn the bed lighting on is inside the truck, which makes no sense. The packages make it hard to get exactly what you want on the lot, I would expect automatic windshield wipers in a top trim truck such as the AT4.... I was very displeased to see that it was not included. I am not impressed with the OnStar phone app because they want to charge an excessive fee on a monthly basis for the application. This was free with my past f150 and my current Range Rover Sport. I was not looking for free, but $15 a month for an application that just allows you to lock and unlock your doors as well as remote start your vehicle is completely absurd. This was included with my wife's 2016 Tahoe, I found out (after leasing) it was not included with my wife's 2019 Escalade. We will not be replacing the escalade with another GM product due to this. Not a deal breaker for my pickup as it is a third vehicle. I love the rear seat space, but it is nothing special for a crew cab pickup. The truck does not offer a full sunroof, only over the front of the cab, again not a dealbreaker for an extra vehicle but would have been if I did not have another primary daily driver.
Safety on lane changes, side vehicle alert crash control, heated seats and steering wheel, and comfort.
It's a great truck so far, there's some issues with the radio but other than that I'd recommend it to anyone
Computer and software issues.
Excellent construction, innovative, extremely safe and reliable.
This is a great truck that is reliable and also has some very innovative technologies.
It's an excellent vehicle with many o options for a small price.
The price, performance, and fuel mileage is better than expected.

reviews.review_text: Well built, reliable vehicle that is pure pleasure to drive
The Macan handles like a performance car and not an SUV.
I have never drive a smoother, quieter car.
Amazing interior and handling, it is a PORSCHE after all
It's fun to drive, it handles and performs well. Hard not to like!
Absolutely worth it and love it
Well built, handles great, strongly recommend
You will love the Macan. It is a joy to drive and handles like a sports car. I recommend it totally.
I got the Miami blue color and you can't miss it when I drive around
Overall performance is excellent. Technology is great but not very intuitive.
It is a fun and exciting vehicle.
Very nice ride, pickup when you step on the gas. Interior very nice, exterior very nice. Drives and looks good. Always get compliments on the vehicle.
Porsche's are made for people who like to drive. When I encounter another Porsche on the road, I feel confident the driver is paying attention to the road and the other drivers.
The Porsche driving experience is off the hook!

reviews.review_text: A luxury family-oriented vehicle with all the safety and luxury bells and whistles.
I love this vehicle it's just missing GPS and some of the advanced features that Infiniti usually has on the dashboard
Awesome driving experience! And very safe.
Good performance. Interior design and space phenominal.
Love this vehicle but wish phone technology was more advanced.  Back up camera system could be better.
Go for it!

In addition for style, quality and technology, free maintenance for several years, in addition to a really good warranty is a major consideration for the Infiniti or any brand. This brand disappointed me in that I was not told free maintenance was not included after I leased the car.  It was an after market option.  Other brands include this service for 2 to 3 years.
Love the. Ride. Peppy and very quiet
Great vehicle Very comfortable
Great Vehicle. Good styling, reliable, spacious and well equipped interior. Lousy Navigation system.
It is a great vehicle.  Highly recommend
Nice drive - small cargo areas and third row
it is a great 3rd row luxury suv.  very safe, very comfortable.  great pickup, and cargo room.
The car is affordable and reliable
The interior has a very quality feel and gives you a good sense of luxury. But, don't let the luxury of the vehicle cloud your judgement, the technology is very much outdated.
Great car, color, with some special features, and third row seating!

I enjoy the ride.  I would have liked the rear seats to completly dissapear into the floor for extra storage.  I needed a bike adapter.  If I want one now it costs $1300.00 (too much).The auto open at the rear tailgate (foot operated) does not work consistently. The leather seats are not ALL leather.  Would have liked the second row seats to be electric operated. Other than the above, I love the SUV.  Great styling.
Make sure you test drive the car.
I would tell them it is a comfortable ride, reasonably priced, great brand the cargo space for a suv crossover is perfect.
It's a great vehicle! Luxurious without an excessive price tag.

cvnaFeatures.description: Auto Leveling Suspension automatically adjusts the vehicle's height or ground clearance to optimize handling and stability.

cvnaFeatures.name: Stability Control

cvnaFeatures.name: Traction Control

cvnaFeatures.name: Alarm System

cvnaFeatures.name: Auto Dimming Mirrors

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic Emergency Braking

cvnaFeatures.name: Blindspot Sensors

cvnaFeatures.name: Front Knee Airbag

cvnaFeatures.name: Front Side Airbag

cvnaFeatures.name: Lane Departure Warning

cvnaFeatures.name: Passenger Airbag

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Side Airbag

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear View Camera

cvnaFeatures.name: Stolen Vehicle Tracking Software
cvnaFeatures.description: Stolen Vehicle Tracking Software is a security feature that uses GPS technology to track the vehicle's location, helping law enforcement to recover the vehicle if it's stolen.

cvnaFeatures.name: Privacy Glass

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Window Defroster
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear Window Defroster uses heating elements to clear frost, ice, or fog from the rear window, improving visibility.

Tesla will notify owners, and will replace the VCM daughterboard with one containing an enhanced eMMC controller, free of charge.

reviews.review_text: It is fun to ride. It find my family of six comfortably. I do road trip with it all the time.
Research...Tesla is not all it is cracked up to be.

The Tesla model X100D is EXACTLY the vehicle we needed.  With two children under the age of 4, plus an Au-Pair, we needed seating for at least 6 people and needed the 3rd row to be able to seat 2 full-sized adults.  We sold our BMW X5 diesel because the 3rd row was too cramped.  The Model X is spacious, fast. quiet and advanced.  Just buy one and be happy.  :-)
Environmental friendliness, performance
You will have no regrets. The future is here

Great driving car. Great acceleration. Very quiet. Seats 7 adults, 5 in fairly good comfort. Jury is out on the falcon wing doors - very cool to look at but can be inconvenient in parking garage with low ceilings.

The Model X is powerful, comfortable, and advanced. I love the view out the massive windshield. It has more squeaks and rattles than other luxury brands, but its technology makes up for it. I power the car completely with solar on my roof, and I am proud to do my tiny part to reduce our dependence on oil.
Great except for long distance travel, no side mirror warning device.
Go for the biggest battery you can afford.

Amazing vehicle. It is so far advanced from anything else on the market. The falcon wing doors are awesome and make getting our 4 year old in and out of the car so much easier. The acceleration is insane and makes the car so fun and easy to drive. I would have a hard time buying anything else in the future.
It is a dream to drive, responsive, agile, safe,  quiet and comfortable.  It is also just fun.
Best drive ever!!! Luxurious, fun, fast, safe and exhilarating.
Pleased with performance, styling, all-electric. Get the biggest battery you can if you plan cross country trips.
The Tesla Model X is a fun to drive automobile and the autopilot is great for long road trips.
It's a great car and I really love it.
This is the car.
You will LOVE it. Best purchase I have ever made.
buy the bigger battery, if you can afford it.  You won't ever regret it.
The Tesla makes the best car I have ever owned.  It drives like a dream.  I have enjoyed owning three, so far.  Bought the first without seeing it and paid for it before I drove it!
Do it!  You will NOT regret your decision!

reviews.review_text: I love the image of my car. Roominess is less than desirable. Fun to drive.

I love my Chevy Camaro convertible. It drives well, gets good mileage, and it looks great. The front seats are roomy, although the car is very low and a little difficult to get in and out of. There is no room in the back seats, though. The backs of the front seats are right against the back seats. It's no problem for me because the only one riding back there is my dog. But passenger-wise, this car is only comfortable for two adult people. Aside from that, this car is amazing. The convertible top comes down and is stored in the trunk, so there is minimal room in the trunk when you are topless. Again, I do not have a problem with this. If I need more room in the trunk, I just don't put the top down. I am looking forward to many years with this car.
I love my convertible Camaro. My car is gorgeous and fast. I don't like the limited amount of space in the back seats. The paint also scratches very easily and is extremely noticeable.
Camaro is a great car with all the power you need and have the most comfortable seats I have ever been in.
Great vehicle runs and drives amazing only thing to look out for is battery problems
If you want a hotrod it's the car to buy.
Será buena compra

If you need back seat room or trunk room this is not for you, but if you don't need that this car is AWSOME !! Also if you're shorter the visibility is better than if your taller because you have more use of adjusting the seats to have a better viewing area.
I would tell them if they're willing to lose out on a little bit of gas but want the mean and aggressive look and sound I would highly recommend them to get a Chevrolet Camaro!
Drive it with the top down and the radio off. The engine and exhaust make a beautiful sound!
I've been waiting for a manufacturer to allow their engineers to build a track focused car for enthusiasts that is well thought out and executed, and for a reasonable price.
The vehicle is a lot of fun to drive. It's not the fastest out there, but has great performance.
Car doesn't hold its value
The Camaro fun to drive good investment !

The Good:  The car is an Absolute Beast when it comes to performance!  Headlight design in 2019 is the best yet, while the tail lights design is the lacking imagination. Amazing improvements across the entire spectrum of vehicle performance and features from the 2011 (exact model)! Really can't emphasize this enough! The Bad:  No navigation option and plugging my phone in every time I get in the car is NOT ACCEPTIBLE!  Needs a front camera to prevent damage while parking or Birdseye view like Nissan Murano. So Ugly (someone should be fired!): Where the hell did the garage door opener buttons go?!? Why is replacing the front collision alert system with a stopwatch and G meter acceptable?!?
It is very powerful car and fun to drive you can feel the adrenalin when you drive it.
Make sure you fit in the seat! Not good for larger people
Very sporty but still affordable.  Good gas mileage
Do it you won't regret it !
It's an amazing cool car

reviews.review_text: Absolutely love my Lincoln MKZ. Drives and handles better than I ever expected it to. Only 2 things I would change are wish it had a digital speedometer and tire sensor to let you know how much air pressure is in each tire.
If you want a luxury car that's also environmentally friendly, this is the car for you!

I'm a car snob...l'll buy pretty much any make of car that has the added features that l require. I love the look of my mkz both interior & exterior l love the mood lighting inside the car is just a real nice car
Luxury, sportiness, and fun are all rolled into one....thats a Lincoln MKZ. Whether its new (pricey) or used (affordable) it won't disappoint.
Great car. Seats could use be a touch more comfortable when driving for a long time.
The air conditioning system needs to be redesigned. The touch screen controls are not good as they are designed. Everything that you have to use while driving should be on one screen.
I would strongly recommend hybrid vehicles. Very happy with mine.
I love the car.
Overall satisfied. The engine noise on acceleration tends to be slightly high. The wheels tend to be a little hard on some surfaces.
I LOVE MY MKZ IT'S STYLISH, WITH THE LOOK OF LUXURY; BUT MOST OF ALL IT RUNS ON REGULAR GAS

Have now noticed a few issues w/car. Armrest controls too far forward. Transmission controls should not be next to touch screen entertainment module. Have often made changes to other functions ( ie.. eject cd, radio controls) when shifting gears or manipulating right side of touch screen. Suspension is very choppy at highway speeds if/when road conditions are rough or weather is windy.

Very impressed with the Lincoln so far after 4 months. Averaging 39.7 mpg. The only drawback is the sound and feel of the CVT, which sounds a bit coarse compared to the quietness on electric. It is only noticeable going up a steep grade on city streets. On the freeway, the transition between gas and electric is imperceptible.
Great riding car.
Always buy American when I can.
I really enjoy my new MKZ. It is the perfect combination of affordability, luxury, dependability (AWD), and adequate power for my needs.
I was disappointed that the fuel tank was reduced in size, limiting the maximum miles between gas stops.
The 2015 Lincoln MKZ exceeds my expectations and surprises my friends.
I was disappointed with rear seat leg room for my passengers
As an engineer working in the automotive field, there are several things I would have liked to see implemented a bit better, especially in the drive train.

There are issues with my vehicle that make it difficult to enjoy. Small little things that irritate you, such as poor windshield wipers. To me, as someone who drives several miles a year, it can make or break my decision about being happy with a vehicle.

reviews.review_text: The C300 is a great value and it rides tremendously well. It has all the amenities needed
Great performance, handles great, looks great. Excellent sound system.

I absolutely love everything about my car. All of the features are perfect except it does not have CarPlay, which is an option that could be added. The interior is so luxurious and comfortable which makes it easy to drive. The car handles really well and has a lot of power.
Beautiful car overall and can be considered a great entry level hybrid.
It [bleeping] whips

The Mercedes AMG C43 is an excellent vehicle for those looking for great performance but do not need the power of the C63 or the size of the E Class. While not as fast in the straight line, it handles great and has a high level of grip when pushing through corners.
Great brand, stylish, long-lasting car.
I love it.
Extremely fun to drive! It has great response time, braking, and of course, the overall appearance inside and out is top notch.
Buy the car! AMG makes an incredible driving machine, very well made cars and craftsmanship.
First rate features.
Acceleration and transmission are amazing for 4 cylinder. Interior craftsmanship is excellent. Front power seat excellent. Should have opted for upgraded entertainment system and heads up display.
Beautiful automobile.
I love the MB C300 and all its technology, power, and comfort.
Very easy to handle. good pick for entering freeway. Quiet.
The C-Class cabriolet is large enough for most convertible users, I suspect.  No need to move up to the E Class.  The AMG acceleration and upgrades that come with it are a bit intoxicating.

Car is over engineered(way too much duplication) and dangerously confusing (awkward switches and switch placement),technology is old (not touch screen!), styling is beautiful, size and comfort great, 2.0 engine a wonderful gas economy surprise. Would buy different vehicle next time if had more experience with alternate brand. Car is very fun to drive and that is the most important reason I bought it.
You won't regret it.
The driving experience is the best I have driven.
Great Quality/Craftmanship.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear View Camera
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear View Camera is a safety feature that provides a video feed of the area behind the vehicle when reversing, displayed on the vehicle's infotainment screen, enhancing visibility and safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Blindspot Sensors
cvnaFeatures.description: Blindspot Sensors are safety features that alert drivers to vehicles or objects in their blind spots, enhancing awareness and safety while changing lanes or parking.

cvnaFeatures.name: Lane Departure Warning
cvnaFeatures.description: Lane Departure Warning is a safety feature that automatically alerts you when the vehicle is drifting out of its lane.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic Emergency Braking
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic Emergency Braking is a proactive safety feature that uses sensors to detect potential collisions and automatically applies the brakes if the driver doesn't react in time.

cvnaFeatures.name: Active Lane Keep Assistance
cvnaFeatures.description: Active Lane Keep Assistance is an intelligent safety feature that helps keep the vehicle centered in its lane by making subtle steering adjustments, enhancing driver safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Adaptive Cruise Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Adaptive Cruise Control is a smart driving aid that automatically adjusts the vehicle's speed to maintain a safe distance from the vehicles in front, reducing driver fatigue and enhancing safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Collision Detection
cvnaFeatures.description: Collision Detection is a proactive safety feature that uses sensors to detect potential collisions and alerts the driver to avoid or minimize the impact, enhancing vehicle safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Pedestrian Detection
cvnaFeatures.description: Pedestrian Detection is a safety feature that uses cameras and radar to identify pedestrians in the vehicle's path, subsequently alerting the driver or initiating automatic braking to prevent potential accidents.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Cross Traffic Alert
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear Cross Traffic Alert is a safety feature that alerts you to vehicles approaching from the side when you're backing out of a parking space or driveway.

cvnaFeatures.name: Alarm System
cvnaFeatures.description: An Alarm System deters theft by sounding an alarm if unauthorized entry is attempted.

cvnaFeatures.name: Driver Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: A Driver Airbag inflates in the event of a collision, providing a cushion to protect the driver from impact.

cvnaFeatures.name: Passenger Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: A Passenger Airbag inflates in the event of a collision, providing a cushion to protect the passenger from impact.

cvnaFeatures.name: Child Seat Anchors
cvnaFeatures.description: Child Seat Anchors provide secure points to attach a child safety seat, enhancing the safety of young passengers.

cvnaFeatures.name: Driver Attention Assist Monitor
cvnaFeatures.description: Driver Attention Assist Monitor detects and alerts drowsy or distracted driving, helping to maintain driver focus and safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Front Head Curtain Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Front Head Curtain Airbag provides head protection for front seat occupants in the event of a side impact or rollover.

cvnaFeatures.name: Front Side Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Front Side Airbag provides additional protection for the chest and abdomen of front seat occupants in the event of a side impact.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Head Curtain Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear Head Curtain Airbag provides head protection for rear seat occupants in the event of a side impact or rollover.

cvnaFeatures.name: Driver Knee Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Driver Knee Airbag provides additional protection for the driver's lower body in the event of a collision.

cvnaFeatures.name: Front Knee Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Front Knee Airbag provides additional protection for the front passenger's lower body in the event of a collision.

cvnaFeatures.name: Traffic Sign Recognition
cvnaFeatures.description: Traffic Sign Recognition is an advanced driver assistance system that uses a camera and, in some cases, navigation data to recognize traffic signs and display them in the driver's instrument cluster, helping to remind the driver of the current speed limit, and other important information.

cvnaFeatures.name: Push Button Start
cvnaFeatures.description: Push Button Start allows you to start and stop the engine by pushing a button, as long as the key fob is inside the vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Tilt Wheel
cvnaFeatures.description: Tilt Wheel is a convenience feature that allows the steering wheel's angle to be adjusted, enhancing driver comfort and ensuring a better fit.

cvnaFeatures.name: Heated Mirrors
cvnaFeatures.description: Heated Mirrors use built-in heating elements to quickly defrost or demist the vehicle's side mirrors, ensuring optimal visibility during cold weather or foggy conditions.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Mirrors
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Mirrors allow you to adjust the angle and orientation of the side mirrors electronically from inside the vehicle without manual adjustment.

cvnaFeatures.name: Keyless Entry
cvnaFeatures.description: Keyless Entry allows you to unlock your vehicle without using a traditional key, often just by having the key fob in your possession.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic Air Conditioning
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic Air Conditioning offers effortless climate control, adjusting temperature and airflow to maintain your preferred cabin environment.

cvnaFeatures.name: Multi-Zone Climate Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Multi-Zone Climate Control allows individual passengers to set their preferred temperature, ensuring optimal comfort for everyone in the vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic Windshield Wipers
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic Windshield Wipers are a convenience feature that automatically adjusts wiper speed based on the amount of rain detected on the windshield, improving visibility and allowing the driver to focus on the road.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Locks
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Locks are a convenience feature that allows you to lock and unlock all doors with the push of a button.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Windows
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Windows are a convenience feature that allows the driver and passengers to raise and lower the windows with the push of a button.

cvnaFeatures.name: Cruise Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Cruise Control is a driving aid that maintains your car's speed, providing a more relaxed long-distance driving experience.

cvnaFeatures.name: Compass
cvnaFeatures.description: Compass is a feature that displays the vehicle's direction of travel, helping with navigation.

cvnaFeatures.name: Air Conditioning
cvnaFeatures.description: Air Conditioning is a comfort feature that cools the vehicle's interior, improving passenger comfort during warmer weather.

cvnaFeatures.name: 115V Power Outlet
cvnaFeatures.description: 115V Power Outlet is a feature that provides a standard power outlet in the vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Lumbar Support
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Lumbar Support offers adjustable support for the lower back, enhancing seat comfort and reducing fatigue on long drives.

cvnaFeatures.name: 12V Power Outlet
cvnaFeatures.description: 12V Power Outlet provides a convenient power source for charging devices or using other electronic accessories in your car.

cvnaFeatures.name: Hands Free Calling
cvnaFeatures.description: Hands Free Calling is a feature that allows you to make and receive phone calls through your vehicle's audio system without taking your hands off the wheel, ensuring safer driving.

cvnaFeatures.name: Bluetooth Music
cvnaFeatures.description: Bluetooth Music is a wireless connectivity feature that allows you to stream music from your mobile device directly to your vehicle's audio system, providing a convenient and cable-free music experience.

cvnaFeatures.name: Apple CarPlay
cvnaFeatures.description: Apple CarPlay® is a seamless in-car connectivity solution which allows you connect your iPhone to the infotainment system for easy access to navigation, communication, and entertainment apps while driving.

cvnaFeatures.name: Android Auto
cvnaFeatures.description: Android Auto™ is a feature that allows you to connect your Android smartphone to your car's infotainment system for easy access to navigation, music, and messaging, through the car's display screen and voice commands.

cvnaFeatures.name: USB Input
cvnaFeatures.description: USB Input allows you to connect a USB device, such as a smartphone or flash drive, to the vehicle's audio or infotainment system, letting you play music, charge devices, or access other media.

cvnaFeatures.name: Voice Recognition System
cvnaFeatures.description: Voice Recognition System allows hands-free control of various vehicle features through voice commands, enhancing safety and convenience.

cvnaFeatures.name: Touch Screen Monitor
cvnaFeatures.description: Touch Screen Monitor is an interactive display on the vehicle's dashboard, allowing easy control of the infotainment system.

cvnaFeatures.name: Smartphone Interface
cvnaFeatures.description: Smartphone Interface allows seamless integration of your smartphone with the vehicle's infotainment system, providing easy access to navigation, communication, and entertainment apps.

cvnaFeatures.name: Steering Wheel Controls
cvnaFeatures.description: Steering Wheel Controls allow you to control the vehicle's audio, cruise control, and other features without taking your hands off the wheel, enhancing safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Audible Text Message Feature
cvnaFeatures.description: Audible Text Message Feature is a convenience feature that reads incoming text messages out loud, allowing the driver to keep their eyes on the road.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Driver Seat
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Driver Seat is a convenience feature that allows you to adjust the driver's seat position and angle electronically, ensuring optimal comfort and visibility.

cvnaFeatures.name: Fold Down Rear Seats
cvnaFeatures.description: Fold Down Rear Seats are a versatile feature that allows the rear seats to be folded down, creating more cargo space when needed.

cvnaFeatures.name: Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel
cvnaFeatures.description: Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel provides a luxurious feel and better grip for improved driving comfort.

cvnaFeatures.name: Synthetic Leather Seats
cvnaFeatures.description: Synthetic Leather Seats provide a premium look and feel, and are typically easier to clean and maintain than cloth seats.

cvnaFeatures.name: Reclining Rear Seats
cvnaFeatures.description: Reclining Rear Seats are a comfort feature that allows the rear seats to be adjusted, enabling passengers to recline their seats for added comfort, especially during long journeys.

cvnaFeatures.name: Alloy Wheels
cvnaFeatures.description: Lightweight alloy wheels improve your car's performance and fuel efficiency, while also enhancing its aesthetics.

cvnaFeatures.name: Tire Pressure Monitor
cvnaFeatures.description: Tire Pressure Monitor is a safety feature that alerts the driver when one or more tires are underinflated, helping to prevent tire-related accidents and improving fuel efficiency.

cvnaFeatures.name: Fog Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: Fog Lights are specially designed lights that provide improved visibility in foggy or misty conditions, enhancing safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Daytime Running Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: Daytime Running Lights automatically switch on when the vehicle is in motion, increasing its visibility to other road users and reducing the likelihood of daytime accidents.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic Headlights
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic Headlights turn on and off based on the surrounding light conditions, enhancing visibility and safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic High Beams
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic High Beams is a smart lighting feature that automatically switches between high and low beams depending on the presence of other vehicles, enhancing visibility and reducing the need to manually change light settings while driving at night.

cvnaFeatures.name: LED Headlamps
cvnaFeatures.description: LED Headlamps use energy-efficient LED bulbs to provide bright and clear illumination, improving visibility and safety while driving at night or in low light conditions.

cvnaFeatures.name: LED Tail Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: LED Tail Lights use energy-efficient LED bulbs to provide bright and clear illumination at the rear of the vehicle, improving visibility for drivers behind you.

cvnaFeatures.name: LED Daytime Running Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: LED Daytime Running Lights are energy-efficient, long-lasting lights that automatically illuminate during the day, enhancing visibility and safety for other drivers.

cvnaFeatures.name: Electronic Stability Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Electronic Stability Control is a safety feature that detects and reduces loss of traction, improving vehicle stability by automatically applying the brakes to individual wheels or reducing engine power.

cvnaFeatures.name: Hill Assistance
cvnaFeatures.description: Hill Assistance refers to a range of systems that help maintain control on slopes by preventing rollback on uphill starts, controlling speed when descending, and keeping the vehicle stationary on inclines until acceleration.

cvnaFeatures.name: Stability Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Stability Control is a safety feature that detects and reduces loss of traction, enhancing vehicle stability and safety during cornering or sudden maneuvers.

cvnaFeatures.name: Traction Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Traction Control is a safety feature that prevents wheel spin by automatically reducing engine power or applying brakes to specific wheels, enhancing vehicle stability.

cvnaFeatures.name: Limited Slip Differential
cvnaFeatures.description: Limited Slip Differential improves traction by distributing power evenly to both wheels, particularly helpful when driving on slippery surfaces.

cvnaFeatures.name: Anti-Lock Brakes
cvnaFeatures.description: Anti-Lock Brakes is a braking system that prevents the wheels from locking up during sudden braking, improving control and reducing the risk of skidding.

cvnaFeatures.name: Roof Rails
cvnaFeatures.description: Roof Rails are a practical feature that allows you to attach cargo carriers or other items to the top of the vehicle, increasing cargo capacity.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Spoiler
cvnaFeatures.description: A Rear Spoiler improves a vehicle's aerodynamics by reducing drag, and also adds a sporty aesthetic to the car.

cvnaFeatures.name: Manual Mode
cvnaFeatures.description: Manual Mode gives the driver the option to manually shift gears in an automatic transmission, offering more control over the vehicle's performance.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Window Defroster
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear Window Defroster uses heating elements to clear frost, ice, or fog from the rear window, improving visibility.

reviews.review_text: Great car but parts can be pricey.
I love the vehicle, had a total loss on my last one.
This car has been an issue since day-one. Build quality is terrible and serviceability is horrible. I will NEVR buy another USED BMW again. It is easy to see why the resale is so low.
The car is very comfortable, powerful, intuitive. My wife definitely loves it and said I have ruined her for buying anything else ever again.
Enjoy the comfort and reliability of my used vehicle. Good fuel economy mixed with a little power to get from A to B
My BMW 535 X Drive us awesome.  Great car, great acceleration,  no problems. Would definitely recommend this car. Sporty, and classy, all in one.
Great vehicle, fun to drive and very economic in fuel
Great car!! Love it so much
Dr. side entry is not easy. It would be great if a CD came with nav instructions.
I am irritated every time I try to place or remove my golf clubs from the trunk, when compared with the Lexus 350, my previous car.
I just wish the step panel lighted up when u open the door
The car is fantastic! The cupholders are a disaster.

Have had much difficulty with the navigation system. Not as easy to operate as my previous E350 MBZ. Also, Bluetooth disconnects frequently when re-entering the vehicle. We've found the cup holders are limited to smaller beverages. Not suitable for larger cups.

The BMW Apps and ConnectedDrive apps were a nightmare to sync up the activation status across the mobile app and the ConnectedDrive Web portal. Web Site does not present the option to add an additional subscriber, at least in my profile.
mirrors should fold in at engine shut off. driver's seat should slide back when drivers door is opened

This is my 3rd 5-series BMW and I tend to own my cars for about 10 years. This car has some design flaws that I find astonishing when I consider the fact that BMW has some of the best engineers in the world. The storage within the console is also home to the charging port and USB port which I use to connect my phone during my long commute. The phone frequently overheats and shuts down because the compartment gets too hot with the lid closed. In my previous E-60 BMW the center console included a tiny vent for some inbound air conditioned air -- to keep a hardwired phone cool. This may seem insignificant but the fact that I must drive around with the console open is a little silly for a $50K+ car! My 2006 E60 BMW also had navigation but it was able to tell me what city/town I was in. Now with the new format I cannot easily tell where I am. There is a lot to like about the new nav system, but knowing what town I am in seems like it should be on the read-out display. The cup holders are a complete failure! Again, in the E60 the cup holders were actually in front of the A/C vents (brilliant!). If I put a drink in the cup holder on a hot day, the drink was kept cool because of the A/C. Now in the new car the cup holders are in a location that puts them in direct sunlight and away from the A/C. Using the updated cup holders is problematic... in the mornings I usually drink a can of soda on the way to work. The only way to get the can into and out of the cup holder without spilling is to partially crush the can. I have resorted to putting electrical tape over a couple of the holders to easily slide a can into and out of the cup holder without spillage.  Again these are small things,  but as a long time owner and loyal to the brand, I expect more from BMW.
Best car I've ever driven. Other cars I get bored and want to stop driving, the BMW 535i is so fun to drive.
The TPM system in the car is horrible. it is not able to sustain cold weather fluctuation and every morning I have been getting problems and is delaying my reaching workplace on time

There are a couple of features I would like to see added to the M5. AWD is the biggest one. I would also like to see power trunk closure, a larger compartment in the center armrest, the ability to lock the glove box, and the European version of adaptive LED headlights. One other feature would be cooled (not just ventilated) seats.

This 2015 BMW M5 is the most amazing car I've ever owned. I already know I want another "M" car for my next purchase! My wife started our obsession with BMWs with a new 2008 328xi coupe. Since then, we've had a 2012 X3, 2012 528xi, 2014 435xi, 2014 640xi Gran Coupe, and now this 2015 M5 (and, that doesn't include two BMW motorcycles). Yep...it's a sickness.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear View Camera
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear View Camera is a safety feature that provides a video feed of the area behind the vehicle when reversing, displayed on the vehicle's infotainment screen, enhancing visibility and safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: 360 Camera
cvnaFeatures.description: 360 Camera is an advanced safety system that provides a bird's-eye view of the area around the vehicle, aiding in parking and maneuvering in tight spaces.

cvnaFeatures.name: Parking Assistance
cvnaFeatures.description: Parking Assistance uses sensors to detect nearby obstacles and provides visual or audible feedback to guide the driver and simplify the parking process.

cvnaFeatures.name: Alarm System
cvnaFeatures.description: An Alarm System deters theft by sounding an alarm if unauthorized entry is attempted.

cvnaFeatures.name: Auto Dimming Mirrors
cvnaFeatures.description: Auto Dimming Mirrors are a safety feature that automatically reduces glare by detecting bright lights and dimming accordingly, providing an improved driving experience during night or low-light conditions.

cvnaFeatures.name: Alloy Wheels
cvnaFeatures.description: Lightweight alloy wheels improve your car's performance and fuel efficiency, while also enhancing its aesthetics.

cvnaFeatures.name: Tilt Wheel
cvnaFeatures.description: Tilt Wheel is a convenience feature that allows the steering wheel's angle to be adjusted, enhancing driver comfort and ensuring a better fit.

cvnaFeatures.name: Heated Mirrors
cvnaFeatures.description: Heated Mirrors use built-in heating elements to quickly defrost or demist the vehicle's side mirrors, ensuring optimal visibility during cold weather or foggy conditions.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Tailgate/Hatch
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Tailgate/Hatch allows you to open and close the vehicle's tailgate or hatch electronically, often via a button on the key fob or inside the vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Mirrors
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Mirrors allow you to adjust the angle and orientation of the side mirrors electronically from inside the vehicle without manual adjustment.

cvnaFeatures.name: Keyless Entry
cvnaFeatures.description: Keyless Entry allows you to unlock your vehicle without using a traditional key, often just by having the key fob in your possession.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Folding Exterior Mirrors
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Folding Exterior Mirrors are mirrors that can be automatically folded inwards, reducing the vehicle's width for tight parking spaces.

cvnaFeatures.name: Multi-Zone Climate Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Multi-Zone Climate Control allows individual passengers to set their preferred temperature, ensuring optimal comfort for everyone in the vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic Windshield Wipers
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic Windshield Wipers are a convenience feature that automatically adjusts wiper speed based on the amount of rain detected on the windshield, improving visibility and allowing the driver to focus on the road.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Windows
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Windows are a convenience feature that allows the driver and passengers to raise and lower the windows with the push of a button.

cvnaFeatures.name: Cruise Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Cruise Control is a driving aid that maintains your car's speed, providing a more relaxed long-distance driving experience.

cvnaFeatures.name: Air Conditioning
cvnaFeatures.description: Air Conditioning is a comfort feature that cools the vehicle's interior, improving passenger comfort during warmer weather.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Climate Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear Climate Controls allow rear passengers to adjust the temperature and airflow in their area, ensuring their comfort.

cvnaFeatures.name: Integrated Garage Door Opener
cvnaFeatures.description: Integrated Garage Door Opener is a feature that allows you to open and close your garage door from the comfort of your vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Daytime Running Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: Daytime Running Lights automatically switch on when the vehicle is in motion, increasing its visibility to other road users and reducing the likelihood of daytime accidents.

cvnaFeatures.name: LED Headlamps
cvnaFeatures.description: LED Headlamps use energy-efficient LED bulbs to provide bright and clear illumination, improving visibility and safety while driving at night or in low light conditions.

cvnaFeatures.name: LED Tail Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: LED Tail Lights use energy-efficient LED bulbs to provide bright and clear illumination at the rear of the vehicle, improving visibility for drivers behind you.

cvnaFeatures.name: LED Daytime Running Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: LED Daytime Running Lights are energy-efficient, long-lasting lights that automatically illuminate during the day, enhancing visibility and safety for other drivers.

cvnaFeatures.name: Premium Brakes
cvnaFeatures.description: Premium Brakes are high-performance braking systems often found in sports or luxury vehicles that offer superior stopping power, heat resistance, and durability, enhancing vehicle safety and performance.

cvnaFeatures.name: Stability Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Stability Control is a safety feature that detects and reduces loss of traction, enhancing vehicle stability and safety during cornering or sudden maneuvers.

cvnaFeatures.name: Traction Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Traction Control is a safety feature that prevents wheel spin by automatically reducing engine power or applying brakes to specific wheels, enhancing vehicle stability.

cvnaFeatures.name: Anti-Lock Brakes
cvnaFeatures.description: Anti-Lock Brakes is a braking system that prevents the wheels from locking up during sudden braking, improving control and reducing the risk of skidding.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Spoiler
cvnaFeatures.description: A Rear Spoiler improves a vehicle's aerodynamics by reducing drag, and also adds a sporty aesthetic to the car.

cvnaFeatures.name: Paddle Shifters
cvnaFeatures.description: Paddle Shifters allow drivers to manually shift gears in an automatic vehicle, offering more control over the vehicle's performance.

reviews.review_text: Love my Q30, my only issue is the moonroof, which does not open; a sunroof is preferred. Also, I missed checking exterior lights, one needs to be replaced and is no longer covered; cost $2500 to repair-very expensive.
Smaller than I was expecting but stylish and luxurious

The overall styling of this car is unique and different. I chose it for its elegance and ability to drive in snowy conditions. It sits higher than most sedans but not as high as an SUV. The car is great for road trips with 1 or 2 people. However, I have issues with adults fitting in the rear because of its small size. Luggage storage is fine for 1 or 2. Gas mileage is above average for a car that performs to this degree. The transmission is sometimes jerky because of the turbo lag off the line. It's something you have to accept, or you may not care for the vehicle long term. It's a 4 cylinder with a turbo for gas efficiency so I'll give it a pass. It accelerates quickly but not as fun to drive as my V6 FX35.
Super fun to drive and maneuver on the freeway; however, still not used to the ""stop-go"" engine in city driving.
It's a sporty car and fun to drive.
I love how it drives.
Love how it handles, looks and feels.
Great quality for price.
Excellent vehicle, excellent value.

Do not be fooled by the title Infiniti. This is an entry-level Infiniti, and if you were spoiled by a previous Infiniti You may not be happy with this particular car. I learned, after purchase, this vehicle was devoid of many of the amenities I was used to with my previous Infiniti. This 2017 vehicle does not even have the amenities from my Nissan 2015. This was very disappointing. I would strongly recommend Recommend you list the amenities that you like and verify that they are available on this vehicle.
Fun, sporty car that drives great!

I really like the way the car handles the road. I do have a few issues with it. You cannot lock it while running and the key in your possession. to move the seats back they are on the door handle and it does not unlock when in park. you must always hit the unlock button to get out of the car. These are important to me because I use them everyday. I do love my car and its body style.

very sporty, complicated operations-too many things on the screen, handles great, styling is awesome, even no blinds spots, love the adaptive cruise control and blind spot indicator, stereo is great and interior noise is low.
The vehicle is great for a commuter and it is fun to drive.
Sporty, fun to drive, great mileage per gallon
The QX30/GLA250 is Great if you don't have kids or rarely transport full sized adults. It's fun to drive and a decent 2 person road trip vehicle.

It is a fast and sporty car with awesome features depending on package level. The QX30 has nimble handling sleek body design. The interior is awesome the leather is so soft and smooth. The only problems are no keyless start or push button start like other Infiniti models
Don't buy it. The blind spots are impossible and there is no room for kids or storage.
Love the way it handles and drives
Get one. They're excellent

reviews.review_text: Great Mercedes Benz- GLC 43 AMG is amazing. She commands attention and does not disappoint.
Stylish, comfortable vehicle with good acceleration and handling.
EASE OF DRIVING, SMART DETAILS, COMFORTABLE
quality build, driving experience

Beautifully designed Benz SUV. Smaller in size for downsizing needs. Works for all my needs, fun to drive, great pick-up with turbo 4 cylinder, handles well, gets great gas mileage with econ mode, and zippy to drive, plus it looks amazing and gets a lot of compliments.
Excellent craftsmanship. Mind blowing interior. Less noise cabin. Eye catching exterior. Worth for money.

don't buy it. this car has been a nightmare. many things wrong and defective. have had to take car in for defective ( squealing brakes) 3 times and have been unable to correct the problem to date. navigational system had to repaired twice. 3 of my electric windows frozen down in 16 degree weather while driving vehicle on expressway at 65 miles an hour to go to medical appointment . charging station broken. Car has proven to be a big disappointment.
Nice vehicle
Superior handling and comfort. FUN to drive!

Consider the vehicle for the comfort of the ride and ability to drive in in climate weather. Do not purchase for overall performance, ease of electronics and infotainment system, the accessibility of the electronic controls, or overall gas mileage. There are much better choices available. I will be disposing of my GLC AMG 43 in another year and will seriously consider getting another BMW, as it performs better overall for the same money. The start/stop function does not perform as well as the option offered by other manufacturers. The tablet should be a touch screen to make it more intuitive. The infotainment system is not logical and difficult to get used to.
Best car I've ever owned. So smooth and luxurious and for an a excellent price. Once you drive a Mercedes Benz you'll never go back to anything else! I'm spoiled!
The car is beautiful, well engineered, comfortable and fun to drive. It is not particularly economical. The technology interfaces can be complicated and prone to failure.
It's a great vehicle with a very smooth ride. Only improvements needed is an increase in leg room for backseat passengers.
Cheap parts are used, head issues with seat belt three time, sun glass holder twice and other minor issues. These are issues you never expect from a brand name such as MB
GLC is great but next time I would buy the GLE
Outstanding quality and performance with very comfortable ride and solid handling. Have owned vehicle for over seven months and still look forward to driving it each and every day!
Love the styling, various driving modes, 360 cameras, adaptive cruise, built-in subwoofer, panoramic roof, a real sweet ride!
Very comfortable. But the car's computer system is not very user friendly. Putting the car in “Drive" and “reverse" is not intuitive for us or for anyone else.

Overall, the car suits my purpose in size, ride, and function. I love the aesthetics of elegant design, and it is quiet in the interior.. However, the car under powered and has a jerky automatic transmission. I don't care for the auto turnoff feature when in idle, as it roughly auto starts. .
Make sure to really test out handling and driving characteristic first.

The Volkswagen Tiguan SE is suitable for every day driving and the occasional adventure. Three row seating is a plus; however, please note that leg room is minimal. These seats do fold down allowing for additional storage which is great for heavy trip packers. It is overall a comfortable ride that can get you where you are going!

I love the Tiguan! It's so roomy for the year that I purchased. I looked at newer ones but they were considerably smaller. It's extremely roomy and has a lot of space for people or stuff you need to transport.

The Volkswagen Tiguan works great for my family of 4. With optional 3rd row, its great for when family visits. Kids do have to go in the back though, as the 3rd row doesn't have a ton of room. It does the job when needed though. I love everything cosmetically about this vehicle!
I love my Tiguan. Great vehicle for a family of 5 that is still good on gas.
I love my vehicle and wish that the size was slightly bigger.
Perfect for storage! Drives amazing and the gas mileage is great! Has great interior & some very luxurious features for a great budget!

We absolutely love our Tiguan. It's a stylish car that has all of the modern luxuries, like seat warmers, back-up cams, Apple CarPlay and so much more. The exterior is sharp, and the interior is comfortable and sleek. Can't recommend this car enough.
Overall I think it's a great car. Very disappointed with the oil changes, was not aware the oil used is so rare and expensive.
Its a nice car but not if you have a family or snow
This vehicle is great family vehicle. It meets our needs and fit our stuff (car seats)

The overall vehicle is fine for someone older or you just do not like and form of speed. I do love the interior black/beige and it's very roomy on the inside. I hate the sound system and how it accelerates from stop.

The Tiguan is the perfect size small SUV. The inside feels luxurious and the tech functions are great (back up assist, lane change warning, front/back car too close). It feels like a luxury vehicle for a better price.
Not to purchase. The car has had issues/problems within a couple of months of owing it.
Love the technology and safety features.
Get it. Great vehicle.
Very good design.
The Tiguan is smooth and quiet. If you want a luxury vehicle without a luxury price tag it is worth considering.
VW Tiguan is the best deal for the cargo room.
Drives smooth; very comfortable; decent price; great exterior; easy to drive.

reviews.review_text: Road noise is terrible, and dash rattles.

The driver's seat does not extend far enough to support under the knee—very uncomfortable. The driver's seat cushion is very hard and uncomfortable. Positioning of brake and gas is too far from the seat; the car is made for people with very long legs. Bad placement of climate controls, the gear shift is in the way. Driver's seat is too low, hard to see through back and front window. Had to purchase a cushion to fix these problems. Exterior scratches extremely easily; there should be a better coating on the paint.
Beautiful car and ride with lots of extras to make driving safe and fun. Great sound system too!
My car is parked at a repair facility for a month and Honda says it will take another month or more to deliver the parts.

The front passenger seat should be adjustable! Back seat should have a phone charger and separate heat/air function. I wish the vehicle had a backup warning sound. Front lights should operate much better in fog; these are terrible.

reviews.review_text: Great fuel mileage, comfortable, roomy, trunk space, overall quality.
Falta entrenamiento en usar todas las funciones y tecnología que tiene el vehículo.

It is a great car that will protect you in case of an accident! The new design is sleek and will turn eyes on the road. All the safety features are great and very helpful while driving long or short distances! I love my new car!!

The seats front and back are NOT at all comfortable. The worst for this car's price point. There is no built-in navigation system, no SiriusXM built-in. You will have to stream all from your connected phone, or buy AT&T wireless. Riding in the back seat will toss you around a bit, especially on long drives. The front console is just a big box with NO USB ports. Back seat area also does NOT have USB ports. The middle of the space between the two front seats is just another space issue, because of the two ports. The port for your phone and charging is another design failure. Please make sure you have the correct USB cables for those two ports. Also, get a package that has memory driver seat positions. This car does not. However, with all the issues that I have (someone else may not have), the car runs well and it is fun to drive. Especially, at 42mpg!
Great on gas. The passenger seat in front sits too low.
You can't go wrong with this vehicle!
You can't go wrong with a Honda Accord.
Honda is a good product.
Just get it. It's a really nice car that accelerates, saves on fuel, and practically drives itself on the highway.
I love the features I have such as wireless car play, remote start from my phone (I can set the inside temperature). Ride is smooth

reviews.review_text: Quite roomy, gets very good gas mileage, enjoyable to drive.

I am very disappointed with the new body style of the 2023 Honda Accord. The space where the windshield wipers and the hood meet collects so many leaves that it is ridiculous. Also, in every seam on the outside of the car, leaves slip in, including back by the trunk. That never happened with my 2007 Honda Accord when I parked in the same driveway. Some of the leaves have traveled to the engine compartment!
Great car for its value. I will buy again.

Best interior design and functionality of a vehicle I've ever had. Gas mileage is great (as you would expect with a hybrid), but you get what you pay. Not cheap, but not over the top either.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Mirrors
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Mirrors allow you to adjust the angle and orientation of the side mirrors electronically from inside the vehicle without manual adjustment.

cvnaFeatures.name: Keyless Entry

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Windows

cvnaFeatures.name: Cruise Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Cruise Control is a driving aid that maintains your car's speed, providing a more relaxed long-distance driving experience.

cvnaFeatures.name: Air Conditioning

cvnaFeatures.name: Integrated Garage Door Opener

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Lumbar Support

cvnaFeatures.name: Fog Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: Fog Lights are specially designed lights that provide improved visibility in foggy or misty conditions, enhancing safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Daytime Running Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: Daytime Running Lights automatically switch on when the vehicle is in motion, increasing its visibility to other road users and reducing the likelihood of daytime accidents.

cvnaFeatures.name: Hill Assistance
cvnaFeatures.description: Hill Assistance refers to a range of systems that help maintain control on slopes by preventing rollback on uphill starts, controlling speed when descending, and keeping the vehicle stationary on inclines until acceleration.

cvnaFeatures.name: Stability Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Stability Control is a safety feature that detects and reduces loss of traction, enhancing vehicle stability and safety during cornering or sudden maneuvers.

cvnaFeatures.name: Traction Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Traction Control is a safety feature that prevents wheel spin by automatically reducing engine power or applying brakes to specific wheels, enhancing vehicle stability.

cvnaFeatures.name: Anti-Lock Brakes
cvnaFeatures.description: Anti-Lock Brakes is a braking system that prevents the wheels from locking up during sudden braking, improving control and reducing the risk of skidding.

cvnaFeatures.name: Roof Rails
cvnaFeatures.description: Roof Rails are a practical feature that allows you to attach cargo carriers or other items to the top of the vehicle, increasing cargo capacity.

reviews.review_text: Great choice if never intend to take a long trip with it. local use only. small battery capacity and Chademo make it a no-go for any roadtrip. level-1 charger is sufficient to top off daily if you don't drive more than 70 miles a day

It's a solid vehicle that gets the job done. Great for running errands around town, probably only makes sense if you can park it next to an outlet where you live though. No adaptive cruise control either, which is a bummer.
Low maintenance, eco friendly, nice infotainment features, and great safety features.
Consider the Leaf due to great value and environmental friendliness
Great car for everything but road trips.
I love it. It is great that I can charge at home or work if needed. My only concern is the range and ability to fast charge, but I have not run into that problem yet.
The Nissan Leaf is a great choice if you want an affordable, reliable EV with smooth handling and zero emissions. Ideal for daily commutes!

Great cost/performance value. It's a good solid vehicle. The downside is poor design of control features. For instance, you cannot set a charging timer to shut off at 80% of full charge. Adding/deleting radio stations for permanent future selection isn't easy. Car must be running to check tire pressure. Pulling the door handle from inside will not automatically open a locked door (safety issue). Car must be shut off for the charge timer to operate. Dumb stuff like this is easy and cheap to fix. Surprised that a 15-year-old vehicle doesn't have these obvious and irritating bugs worked out. The list goes on and on.
We are having intermittent charge issues. We would not recommend people buy this car and will not purchase another Leaf again. We were loyal customers and recommenders prior to this.
