reviews.review_text: I love the reliability of the Ford Escape. Plenty of room to haul stuff and the Escape is very comfortable to drive.

Great car! I love that it kinda adapts to your needs. Like turning the A/C down a little while you make a phone call so you can hear better. The heated seats get HOT! I love it. The A/C is powerful. It works super fast! I'm not hot or cold for very long. For the price, this is a great car!
Very great commuter vehicle. No crazy bells and whistles. Comfortable, and very easy to enjoy the ride.
Reliable, safe, solid, roomy, quiet, enjoyable drive. Not flashy, but gets you anywhere you need to go.
It's great, but still got a problem with the trunk. Probably need to change the lock or something.
Still having a few issues with the vehicle but love the car. It needs to have the ABS system fixed, though.
I love it. I had an older escape and liked it so much I bought a newer one, but this time the color I wanted and seat warmers.
Great overall vehicle.
I needed a car for a limited amount of time that would hold its value. I found that in the 2018 Escape I purchased. I had 5 Escapes as company cars that were all great, that is why I chose an Escape.

A great car for a small family, it's roomy enough for camping trips, shopping, etc. It's a great little car with good fuel economy and is fun to drive. It has some high-tech features that give a feeling of luxury, yet at the same time, it's practical transportation.
Assuming the transmission lasts it's a good car. Exterior looks are mild and not really impressive. Looks like every car.
The 2019 Ford Escape is fine. Nothing really impressive to write home about, but it gets you from one place to the other. The seats are cushy and controls are great. No complaints really.
I love the roominess in the driver seat and all the adjustments of the seat. The cargo area is perfect especially when the 2 middle seats are down.

I absolutely love my car. It's beautiful aesthetically and functional. It's runs perfectly and I haven't had any issues. I love the interior user interface, the back up camera, the room inside, and the comfort of driving it.

We wanted a vehicle that you can get a lot in, folding the back seat down allows that. You can also tow things. Nice compromise if wanting a truck, but not able to afford one. The handling and gas mileage are good too. Also a lot of room and comfortable. We love ours. Would buy again.
Great midsize SUV with good interior room, gas milage and ease of maintenance
I feel safe in my vehicle and so far, it's been very dependable. I like Ford's quality reputation.

This is our second Ford Escape and we have thoroughly enjoyed both vehicles. It's big enough to meet our needs without being overly large and bulky. It's very comfortable, even for someone like me who's 6' 3"" tall.
Ford Escape, excellent gas mileage, very roomy and comfortable, has plenty of power and pick up and very easy and fun to drive.
Quiet, great acceleration. Electrical system already failed, had a major repair within 35k miles. Turn radius is terrible.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear View Camera
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear View Camera is a safety feature that provides a video feed of the area behind the vehicle when reversing, displayed on the vehicle's infotainment screen, enhancing visibility and safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Blindspot Sensors
cvnaFeatures.description: Blindspot Sensors are safety features that alert drivers to vehicles or objects in their blind spots, enhancing awareness and safety while changing lanes or parking.

cvnaFeatures.name: Lane Departure Warning
cvnaFeatures.description: Lane Departure Warning is a safety feature that automatically alerts you when the vehicle is drifting out of its lane.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic Emergency Braking
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic Emergency Braking is a proactive safety feature that uses sensors to detect potential collisions and automatically applies the brakes if the driver doesn't react in time.

cvnaFeatures.name: Active Lane Keep Assistance
cvnaFeatures.description: Active Lane Keep Assistance is an intelligent safety feature that helps keep the vehicle centered in its lane by making subtle steering adjustments, enhancing driver safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Adaptive Cruise Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Adaptive Cruise Control is a smart driving aid that automatically adjusts the vehicle's speed to maintain a safe distance from the vehicles in front, reducing driver fatigue and enhancing safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Parking Assistance
cvnaFeatures.description: Parking Assistance uses sensors to detect nearby obstacles and provides visual or audible feedback to guide the driver and simplify the parking process.

cvnaFeatures.name: Collision Detection
cvnaFeatures.description: Collision Detection is a proactive safety feature that uses sensors to detect potential collisions and alerts the driver to avoid or minimize the impact, enhancing vehicle safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Pedestrian Detection
cvnaFeatures.description: Pedestrian Detection is a safety feature that uses cameras and radar to identify pedestrians in the vehicle's path, subsequently alerting the driver or initiating automatic braking to prevent potential accidents.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Cross Traffic Alert
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear Cross Traffic Alert is a safety feature that alerts you to vehicles approaching from the side when you're backing out of a parking space or driveway.

cvnaFeatures.name: Alarm System
cvnaFeatures.description: An Alarm System deters theft by sounding an alarm if unauthorized entry is attempted.

cvnaFeatures.name: Driver Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: A Driver Airbag inflates in the event of a collision, providing a cushion to protect the driver from impact.

cvnaFeatures.name: Passenger Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: A Passenger Airbag inflates in the event of a collision, providing a cushion to protect the passenger from impact.

cvnaFeatures.name: Child Seat Anchors
cvnaFeatures.description: Child Seat Anchors provide secure points to attach a child safety seat, enhancing the safety of young passengers.

cvnaFeatures.name: Front Head Curtain Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Front Head Curtain Airbag provides head protection for front seat occupants in the event of a side impact or rollover.

cvnaFeatures.name: Front Side Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Front Side Airbag provides additional protection for the chest and abdomen of front seat occupants in the event of a side impact.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Head Curtain Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear Head Curtain Airbag provides head protection for rear seat occupants in the event of a side impact or rollover.

cvnaFeatures.name: Driver Knee Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Driver Knee Airbag provides additional protection for the driver's lower body in the event of a collision.

cvnaFeatures.name: Front Knee Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Front Knee Airbag provides additional protection for the front passenger's lower body in the event of a collision.

cvnaFeatures.name: Traffic Sign Recognition
cvnaFeatures.description: Traffic Sign Recognition is an advanced driver assistance system that uses a camera and, in some cases, navigation data to recognize traffic signs and display them in the driver's instrument cluster, helping to remind the driver of the current speed limit, and other important information.

cvnaFeatures.name: Heated Seats
cvnaFeatures.description: Heated Seats are a comfort feature that warms the vehicle's seats, providing extra comfort during colder weather.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Driver Seat
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Driver Seat is a convenience feature that allows you to adjust the driver's seat position and angle electronically, ensuring optimal comfort and visibility.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Passenger Seat
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Passenger Seat is a convenience feature that allows your passenger to adjust their seat position and angle electronically, ensuring their comfort.

cvnaFeatures.name: Fold Down Rear Seats
cvnaFeatures.description: Fold Down Rear Seats are a versatile feature that allows the rear seats to be folded down, creating more cargo space when needed.

cvnaFeatures.name: Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel
cvnaFeatures.description: Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel provides a luxurious feel and better grip for improved driving comfort.

cvnaFeatures.name: Synthetic Leather Seats
cvnaFeatures.description: Synthetic Leather Seats provide a premium look and feel, and are typically easier to clean and maintain than cloth seats.

cvnaFeatures.name: Reclining Rear Seats
cvnaFeatures.description: Reclining Rear Seats are a comfort feature that allows the rear seats to be adjusted, enabling passengers to recline their seats for added comfort, especially during long journeys.

cvnaFeatures.name: Push Button Start
cvnaFeatures.description: Push Button Start allows you to start and stop the engine by pushing a button, as long as the key fob is inside the vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Tilt Wheel
cvnaFeatures.description: Tilt Wheel is a convenience feature that allows the steering wheel's angle to be adjusted, enhancing driver comfort and ensuring a better fit.

cvnaFeatures.name: Heated Mirrors
cvnaFeatures.description: Heated Mirrors use built-in heating elements to quickly defrost or demist the vehicle's side mirrors, ensuring optimal visibility during cold weather or foggy conditions.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Tailgate/Hatch
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Tailgate/Hatch allows you to open and close the vehicle's tailgate or hatch electronically, often via a button on the key fob or inside the vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Mirrors
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Mirrors allow you to adjust the angle and orientation of the side mirrors electronically from inside the vehicle without manual adjustment.

cvnaFeatures.name: Keyless Entry
cvnaFeatures.description: Keyless Entry allows you to unlock your vehicle without using a traditional key, often just by having the key fob in your possession.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Adjustable Steering Column
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Adjustable Steering Column is a convenience feature that allows you to adjust the height and distance of the steering wheel electronically, providing a more comfortable driving position.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Folding Exterior Mirrors
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Folding Exterior Mirrors are mirrors that can be automatically folded inwards, reducing the vehicle's width for tight parking spaces.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic Air Conditioning
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic Air Conditioning offers effortless climate control, adjusting temperature and airflow to maintain your preferred cabin environment.

cvnaFeatures.name: Multi-Zone Climate Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Multi-Zone Climate Control allows individual passengers to set their preferred temperature, ensuring optimal comfort for everyone in the vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic Windshield Wipers
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic Windshield Wipers are a convenience feature that automatically adjusts wiper speed based on the amount of rain detected on the windshield, improving visibility and allowing the driver to focus on the road.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Locks
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Locks are a convenience feature that allows you to lock and unlock all doors with the push of a button.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Windows
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Windows are a convenience feature that allows the driver and passengers to raise and lower the windows with the push of a button.

cvnaFeatures.name: Cruise Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Cruise Control is a driving aid that maintains your car's speed, providing a more relaxed long-distance driving experience.

cvnaFeatures.name: Air Conditioning
cvnaFeatures.description: Air Conditioning is a comfort feature that cools the vehicle's interior, improving passenger comfort during warmer weather.

cvnaFeatures.name: Integrated Garage Door Opener
cvnaFeatures.description: Integrated Garage Door Opener is a feature that allows you to open and close your garage door from the comfort of your vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Lumbar Support
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Lumbar Support offers adjustable support for the lower back, enhancing seat comfort and reducing fatigue on long drives.

cvnaFeatures.name: 12V Power Outlet
cvnaFeatures.description: 12V Power Outlet provides a convenient power source for charging devices or using other electronic accessories in your car.

cvnaFeatures.name: Bluetooth Music
cvnaFeatures.description: Bluetooth Music is a wireless connectivity feature that allows you to stream music from your mobile device directly to your vehicle's audio system, providing a convenient and cable-free music experience.

cvnaFeatures.name: Apple CarPlay
cvnaFeatures.description: Apple CarPlay® is a seamless in-car connectivity solution which allows you connect your iPhone to the infotainment system for easy access to navigation, communication, and entertainment apps while driving.

cvnaFeatures.name: Android Auto
cvnaFeatures.description: Android Auto™ is a feature that allows you to connect your Android smartphone to your car's infotainment system for easy access to navigation, music, and messaging, through the car's display screen and voice commands.

cvnaFeatures.name: USB Input
cvnaFeatures.description: USB Input allows you to connect a USB device, such as a smartphone or flash drive, to the vehicle's audio or infotainment system, letting you play music, charge devices, or access other media.

cvnaFeatures.name: Voice Recognition System
cvnaFeatures.description: Voice Recognition System allows hands-free control of various vehicle features through voice commands, enhancing safety and convenience.

cvnaFeatures.name: Touch Screen Monitor
cvnaFeatures.description: Touch Screen Monitor is an interactive display on the vehicle's dashboard, allowing easy control of the infotainment system.

cvnaFeatures.name: CD Player
cvnaFeatures.description: CD Player is an audio device that plays CDs, providing additional entertainment options for the vehicle's audio system.

cvnaFeatures.name: Smartphone Interface
cvnaFeatures.description: Smartphone Interface allows seamless integration of your smartphone with the vehicle's infotainment system, providing easy access to navigation, communication, and entertainment apps.

cvnaFeatures.name: Steering Wheel Controls
cvnaFeatures.description: Steering Wheel Controls allow you to control the vehicle's audio, cruise control, and other features without taking your hands off the wheel, enhancing safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Auxiliary Input Jack
cvnaFeatures.description: Auxiliary Input Jack allows you to connect external audio devices to the vehicle's audio system, providing a wider range of entertainment options.

cvnaFeatures.name: Audible Text Message Feature
cvnaFeatures.description: Audible Text Message Feature is a convenience feature that reads incoming text messages out loud, allowing the driver to keep their eyes on the road.

cvnaFeatures.name: Alloy Wheels
cvnaFeatures.description: Lightweight alloy wheels improve your car's performance and fuel efficiency, while also enhancing its aesthetics.

cvnaFeatures.name: Tire Pressure Monitor
cvnaFeatures.description: Tire Pressure Monitor is a safety feature that alerts the driver when one or more tires are underinflated, helping to prevent tire-related accidents and improving fuel efficiency.

cvnaFeatures.name: Fog Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: Fog Lights are specially designed lights that provide improved visibility in foggy or misty conditions, enhancing safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Daytime Running Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: Daytime Running Lights automatically switch on when the vehicle is in motion, increasing its visibility to other road users and reducing the likelihood of daytime accidents.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic Headlights
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic Headlights turn on and off based on the surrounding light conditions, enhancing visibility and safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic High Beams
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic High Beams is a smart lighting feature that automatically switches between high and low beams depending on the presence of other vehicles, enhancing visibility and reducing the need to manually change light settings while driving at night.

cvnaFeatures.name: LED Headlamps
cvnaFeatures.description: LED Headlamps use energy-efficient LED bulbs to provide bright and clear illumination, improving visibility and safety while driving at night or in low light conditions.

cvnaFeatures.name: LED Tail Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: LED Tail Lights use energy-efficient LED bulbs to provide bright and clear illumination at the rear of the vehicle, improving visibility for drivers behind you.

cvnaFeatures.name: LED Daytime Running Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: LED Daytime Running Lights are energy-efficient, long-lasting lights that automatically illuminate during the day, enhancing visibility and safety for other drivers.

cvnaFeatures.name: Hill Assistance
cvnaFeatures.description: Hill Assistance refers to a range of systems that help maintain control on slopes by preventing rollback on uphill starts, controlling speed when descending, and keeping the vehicle stationary on inclines until acceleration.

cvnaFeatures.name: Stability Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Stability Control is a safety feature that detects and reduces loss of traction, enhancing vehicle stability and safety during cornering or sudden maneuvers.

cvnaFeatures.name: Traction Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Traction Control is a safety feature that prevents wheel spin by automatically reducing engine power or applying brakes to specific wheels, enhancing vehicle stability.

cvnaFeatures.name: Adjustable Suspension
cvnaFeatures.description: Adjustable Suspension allows for modification of the vehicle's suspension, enhancing driving comfort and performance based on road conditions and driver preference.

cvnaFeatures.name: Anti-Lock Brakes
cvnaFeatures.description: Anti-Lock Brakes is a braking system that prevents the wheels from locking up during sudden braking, improving control and reducing the risk of skidding.

cvnaFeatures.name: Roof Rails
cvnaFeatures.description: Roof Rails are a practical feature that allows you to attach cargo carriers or other items to the top of the vehicle, increasing cargo capacity.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Spoiler
cvnaFeatures.description: A Rear Spoiler improves a vehicle's aerodynamics by reducing drag, and also adds a sporty aesthetic to the car.

cvnaFeatures.name: Manual Mode
cvnaFeatures.description: Manual Mode gives the driver the option to manually shift gears in an automatic transmission, offering more control over the vehicle's performance.

cvnaFeatures.name: Paddle Shifters
cvnaFeatures.description: Paddle Shifters allow drivers to manually shift gears in an automatic vehicle, offering more control over the vehicle's performance.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Window Defroster
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear Window Defroster uses heating elements to clear frost, ice, or fog from the rear window, improving visibility.

reviews.review_text: I like my NX350h because it's peppy and strong for its size and still practical for everyday living. I chose the luxury brand because it's feels more solidly-built and comfortable.
Love the versatility of my vehicle and its awesome quality
The battery is great for driving around town and saving on gas. Very fuel efficient and I love the color of the interior and apple car play.
It's a great SUV, it's my first Lexus and I couldn't be happier.
It has everything someone wanting a luxury car at a modest price would want.
Rear visibility is poor, but fortunately my NX has a rear view wide angle camera. This is an absolutely wonderful addition.
It's a fantastic vehicle.

I have the NX350h and is very spacious. It has a lot of technology and gets updates every other day plus is a hybrid, so is extremely good in saving gasoline. Everywhere I go people look amazed. Also is a very beautiful SUV, it gets a lot attention.
My Lexus is outstanding.  It provides comfort, durability, and suitability for my taste.
Love the smooth comfortable, safe ride!
Impressed with the dashboard layout and safety features
I like how my Lexus NX accelerates more smoothly compared to my Toyota RAV4.
Has a great EV range, smooth ride and easy to use infotainment system.
Sticker performance may not be realistic. Service department told me those numbers are "Marketing" and only achievable under pristine conditions!
This is my 11th Lexus and I wouldn't buy any other cars. I think that statement says a lot about what I think of this car.
Great features.  The lane assist for long drives is fantastic.  Handles well.  Does not get the advertised fuel economy (mpg).
Not as efficient as advertised, but still very good. Good quality. Cruise control controls are pretty bad.
Drive it. You will love it!
Don't believe in run flat tires.
there is no cd player capability in this car and no heads up display

reviews.review_text: I really love the overall look and practicality of this car. I also like the safety features it has which drives down the insurance rates. I think for what I needed it for which is a point A to point B car, it is a very safe reliable car. I think the only thing that they could have done better was add some more horsepower. It does the job but it could definitely use a little more go power.
I appreciate the reputation and reliability and positive reviews of my Subaru Impreza on Consumer Reports and elsewhere. It drives well and I love the safety features.

The things I love about my Subaru Impreza is the comfort of seating, the feeling of safety, and the reliability. The AWD is great on backroads and/or off main roads. I love the anti-theft alarm system. One time, the car alerted me of a deflated tire by sounding an alarm twice! I do not regret my purchase. I love it!
Great overall car, brakes squeak too much and needs a better sound system!
the vehicle is fantastic. i would recommend this year impreza to anyone
Good bargain for the money, reliable and easy to drive

Subaru is the only car my late brother would own so as in memory I continue to buy only Subaru. There value is amazing in trade in and sale of used. There safety is amazing, when I got into a collision my car was not even dented while the Honda was smushed. No one was hurt...Love   Subaru
Great compact car, roomy interior, useful cargo capacity, 4WD, good safety features, responsive handling. Adequate power, good economy.
Great value car, trustworthy brand
Does the job it was designed for.
AWD system is excellent. The low/normal ground clearance and profile are good to have in high winds.
The Subaru Impreza seems to be a popular car in this area for good reasons.

Trunk is small. Back windshield refracts headlights making it difficult to see at night. No good place to store sunglasses. Unlike proper model, does not pair with iPod. Also had to buy car even though I did not like the available colors because old car destroyed in accident. I much preferred [Name] Green color and the greyish blue but Subaru no longer offers Impreza in those colors.
Do it. It's great. Everything you need and highly affordable.

I live in Ohio, Subarus are the safest and the best in snow and on other slick surfaces.  And Imprezas are the least expensive AWD vehicles.  Subarus are durable, relatively low maintenance and long lasting.
The car has so many safety features, it makes me feel more secure.  It is easy to handle and looks really pretty.
It is extremely efficient and practical for the price.
It's sporty and slick.
Dependable, Safe, Fun To Drive
It has a nice smooth ride and it is fairly quiet when going down the road.  I should have purchased a higher level model with heated seats and blind spot monitor and reverse braking for obstacles.

reviews.review_text: Reliable in the cold weather. Tech is all in one and hard to change climate controls or engage 4 wheel drive when driving.
My forester runs great. I went with Subaru because of its great reputation for safety and reliability.

nicely equipped safety features, you won't get the gas mileage Subaru says you will, the built in navigation system is extremely lousy for such a costly vehicle. Subaru needs to get rid of their contract. It can't even redirect you if you turn incorrectly on the wrong road.
My Subaru is by far the best vehicle I've ever owned, and I've owned a lot of vehicles. Hands down, I will always choose Subaru over any other manufacturer.
My subaru is a rattle trap less than a thousand miles and the rattle is driving me crazy
The brand is reliable, has a good reputation and the newest and best of everything! You will not be disappointed!
Great safety features. A lot of car for the money.
excellent design, Subaru has a community-minded focus that is appreciated.
Great lumbar support and seat comfort. Very roomy. Great trunk space. Wish it had a CD player.
I often recommend Foresters to others. They are safe, reliable, last forever and are great in the winter.
I want a CD player back. I hate Sirius
Love the safety and comfort features, the sound system, the larger monitor screen
I would buy my Forester again and again. It's a joy to drive, I feel safe and protected, it's comfortable and very good looking!
It is reliable and drives smoothly. It is comfortable and has many safety features.
It is an overall awesome car with great resale value.
The Forester is fun to drive, comfortable, safe and has all the features you could want.
Do it ; it's an excellent car from the best manufacturer!
The Forester is a wonderful vehicle with superb safety features! However, you cannot open your garage door unless you attach a separate button.
Well-made, safe, reliable.
Very comfortable, safe and capable.

reviews.review_text: My Mazda CX-30 is both luxurious and sporty, all in one.  The extra details are more than I expected; it is a beautiful car.
Found exactly what I needed in a short amount of time. The car is very reliable and clean!
This vehicle is great both interior and exterior wise. Very smooth and while it may be a crossover it is very comfortable.
Love: Very nice looking vehicle. Interior is great. Pretty good on gas. Good use of space for a compact SUV.

The Mazda CX-30 I purchased is sporty, sharp and well apportioned with the best and latest electronic wizardry. The ride is exceptional, quiet and smooth. This is the best part not to mention the all wheel drive and good MPG. I consider myself a conservative driver conscience of fuel economy and safety. I get all of this with the CX-30. The only derogatory thing I can say is the rear seating must be for either children or midgets. I would have a hard time using the rear seating for leg room and overhead space and I am 5 foot 10, average size. Since it's only my wife and I when we travel it does work out but as a family sized car, I would go with the CX-5 or greater.

Living in Minnesota winters I worried about ice handling and this was amazing and almost no slippage. Biggest con is the small backseat can only fit 2 small kids in the backseat. Not meant for tall people.

I really like my CX-30.  The styling is nice.  It has a higher level of comfort and luxury than my previous car.  It is slightly smaller than a CX-5 but basically the same.  The windows are a little more narrow than the 5. I have to bend my arm forward and then out the window. Interior is very comfortable otherwise for a 6ft tall guy. Back seats are not designed for tall people.
Great car for the price
Looks great and fun to drive

The standard package is not enough. If you live in places with low temperatures, get the heated seats and steering wheel because the standard package makes for miserable frigid temperatures in the car even with remote start. The cargo door is heavy, so opt for the package that offers electronic cargo door operation.
Size and comfort is important. This vehicle is too small in both respects.
You won't be disappointed! Awesome vehicle

I rides very well, the heads up display is very nice. The navigation/carplay system is good. The Bose sound system is pretty nice for a car of this cost. It gets great gas mileage and is surprisingly good off road. The active cruise control and auto hold are the two best things going for this car, it makes it so easy to live with on congested commutes. The interior is a really nice place to sit. The black & brown color combo is so classy and the interior materials punch way above their weight for a car in this class. I'd also like to commend Mazda on the infotainment eschewing touch controls. I much prefer the command knob because I can focus more on driving than messing with the screen. The HVAC control layout is so simple and intuitive and other companies could take a lesson on design. This car handles more like a car than an SUV, it honestly feels very nimble on curvy roads.
Surprising sleek and classy for a crossover suv-type vehicle. I never realized how fun driving would be! Very satisfying, and overall very superior vehicle.
Don't plan on being able to lock the car and walk away after you've started it. It's impossible to lock the doors. Who designs a door that you can't lock?
The CX-30 is a super sexy looking car, that drives great for a sun compact, the interior feels so much more upscale than expected. I love the traditional 6 speed transmission.
Great ride and bang for your buck
the cx-30 is a safe, comfortable vehicle in unsteady times.
Very good in snow and is easy to drive and looks great
Drive it, you will love it.

reviews.review_text: My Buick Enclave used car has good interior/exterior design. Overall drives very comfortable, and overall, the vehicle is very reliable.
Feel like I got the best value for a 3rd row SUV. It fits my family of 5 perfectly for our needs.
The new 2019 Buick Enclave provides a great driving experience, good gas mileage, and the utility I need for my family.
This vehicle offers all the amenities of a luxury vehicle that compares to BMW, Audi, etc. but a grater value for the money
Solid vehicle that is quiet and versatile.
The Buick Enclave is well worth the money.
buy it--great driving machine--comfortable---not your dad's Buick
The Enclave is not a cookie cutter style
The gas mileage isn't the best and it has low clearance.  Climate control is not very good or easy to use.
Best vehicle at this price point for the size and included features.
I love the Buick Enclave, the one thing I'm disappointing with is the storage area under the council, it's useless because it's hard to get to.  A better design should replace his.
Simple and luxurious.
Make sure you can get into your garage if you use one
It is a great vehicle for long trips--it's comfortable and spacious. My only complaint is the rear back up camera does not operate well at night--it's very hard to see when backing up in dark areas.
Go get one.
Spacious, good driving experience, potent and elegant design.
It is a great ride with great options and room.
Good :  performance, fuel economy, quiet, roomy. Bad: Lots of features that one would expect in a vehicle of this MSRP  are missing in this Buick.

That we loved our previous Buick Enclave and are still learning some of the "how to's" of our new Enclave's features. I would tell them the new "start/stop" technology takes getting used to, but now is not an issue and would recommend purchasing. I would tell them if driving in snow/ice worries them, AWD is great.
If you need luggage space and passenger room with good fuel economy and comfortable ride this is the vehicle to get.

reviews.review_text: High learning curve. Not very user friendly. Gas mileage stated is not achievable. Air conditioning system is inadequate.
Fun ride, good entertainment options, but difficult placement of entertainment and climate controls and aggravating safety warnings and actions.

The safety features of the Mazda were put to the test when I was t-boned in an intersection. My CX-5 took the blow like a champ and saved me from worse injury. There was no other brand for me when I had to replace it. Although I am disappointed in Mazda's customer service responsiveness, the car kept me with the brand.
Great Vehicle all around, performance and safety are Top Notch.
The Mazda CX-5 is a very comfortable SUV to ride in and very responsive. I especially like the turning radius. The display is easy to read and adjustable. I feel very safe driving this model vehicle.
We love it. Comfortable and modern, good fuel economy.
It's a great size everyday car at a great price that drives well and looks sleek and clean. A car you'll be proud to own.
Perfect size for me. Plenty of room to transport purchases, good gas mileage. Looks great and drives great!

This vehicle is smooth and makes me feel safe while driving, which is very important to me, personally. I drive daily for a living, in a big city, so all the safety features are key aspects. It's also roomy, and the exterior is beautiful, but the interior is even better. High quality products used, feels luxe. Would definitely recommend for others looking for a SUV/Crossover vehicle.
I love the car. The gas mileage is great and it is enjoyable to drive.

cvnaFeatures.name: Sunroof

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Window Defroster
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear Window Defroster uses heating elements to clear frost, ice, or fog from the rear window, improving visibility.

cvnaFeatures.name: Genuine Leather Seats
cvnaFeatures.description: Genuine Leather Seats offer a luxurious feel and superior comfort for both driver and passengers.

cvnaFeatures.name: Heated Seats
cvnaFeatures.description: Heated Seats are a comfort feature that warms the vehicle's seats, providing extra comfort during colder weather.

cvnaFeatures.name: Heated and Ventilated Seats
cvnaFeatures.description: Heated and Ventilated Seats is a comfort feature that can heat you up or cool you down, providing comfort in any weather condition.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Driver Seat
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Driver Seat is a convenience feature that allows you to adjust the driver's seat position and angle electronically, ensuring optimal comfort and visibility.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Passenger Seat
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Passenger Seat is a convenience feature that allows your passenger to adjust their seat position and angle electronically, ensuring their comfort.

cvnaFeatures.name: Fold Down Rear Seats
cvnaFeatures.description: Fold Down Rear Seats are a versatile feature that allows the rear seats to be folded down, creating more cargo space when needed.

cvnaFeatures.name: Seat Memory System
cvnaFeatures.description: Seat Memory System is a convenience feature that remembers the preferred seat and mirror settings for multiple drivers, adjusting them automatically when each driver uses the vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel
cvnaFeatures.description: Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel provides a luxurious feel and better grip for improved driving comfort.

cvnaFeatures.name: Interior Ambient Lighting
cvnaFeatures.description: Interior Ambient Lighting enhances the vehicle's interior aesthetics and can be adjusted to suit the driver's mood or preference.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Heated Seats
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear Heated Seats warm the vehicle's rear seats, providing extra comfort for passengers during colder weather.

cvnaFeatures.name: GPS Navigation
cvnaFeatures.description: An advanced feature that provides real-time GPS navigation, guiding you to your destination with visual and spoken directions.

cvnaFeatures.name: Hands Free Calling
cvnaFeatures.description: Hands Free Calling is a feature that allows you to make and receive phone calls through your vehicle's audio system without taking your hands off the wheel, ensuring safer driving.

cvnaFeatures.name: Bluetooth Music
cvnaFeatures.description: Bluetooth Music is a wireless connectivity feature that allows you to stream music from your mobile device directly to your vehicle's audio system, providing a convenient and cable-free music experience.

cvnaFeatures.name: Premium Sound System
cvnaFeatures.description: Premium Sound Systems provide superior audio quality through high-quality speakers, amplifiers, and subwoofers, enhancing the enjoyment of music and other audio.

cvnaFeatures.name: Apple CarPlay
cvnaFeatures.description: Apple CarPlay® is a seamless in-car connectivity solution which allows you connect your iPhone to the infotainment system for easy access to navigation, communication, and entertainment apps while driving.

cvnaFeatures.name: USB Input
cvnaFeatures.description: USB Input allows you to connect a USB device, such as a smartphone or flash drive, to the vehicle's audio or infotainment system, letting you play music, charge devices, or access other media.

cvnaFeatures.name: Voice Recognition System
cvnaFeatures.description: Voice Recognition System allows hands-free control of various vehicle features through voice commands, enhancing safety and convenience.

cvnaFeatures.name: MP3 Player
cvnaFeatures.description: MP3 Player provides the capability to play MP3 files, allowing you to enjoy a wide variety of digital music through the vehicle's audio system.

cvnaFeatures.name: Smartphone Interface
cvnaFeatures.description: Smartphone Interface allows seamless integration of your smartphone with the vehicle's infotainment system, providing easy access to navigation, communication, and entertainment apps.

cvnaFeatures.name: Steering Wheel Controls
cvnaFeatures.description: Steering Wheel Controls allow you to control the vehicle's audio, cruise control, and other features without taking your hands off the wheel, enhancing safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Real-Time Traffic Information
cvnaFeatures.description: Real-Time Traffic Information provides up-to-date traffic updates through the vehicle's infotainment system, helping you avoid traffic congestion and find faster routes.

cvnaFeatures.name: Built-In Hard Drive
cvnaFeatures.description: Built-In Hard Drive provides storage for music and other digital files within the vehicle, allowing you to access your media library on the go.

cvnaFeatures.name: Auxiliary Input Jack
cvnaFeatures.description: Auxiliary Input Jack allows you to connect external audio devices to the vehicle's audio system, providing a wider range of entertainment options.

cvnaFeatures.name: Audible Text Message Feature
cvnaFeatures.description: Audible Text Message Feature is a convenience feature that reads incoming text messages out loud, allowing the driver to keep their eyes on the road.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear View Camera
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear View Camera is a safety feature that provides a video feed of the area behind the vehicle when reversing, displayed on the vehicle's infotainment screen, enhancing visibility and safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Blindspot Sensors
cvnaFeatures.description: Blindspot Sensors are safety features that alert drivers to vehicles or objects in their blind spots, enhancing awareness and safety while changing lanes or parking.

cvnaFeatures.name: Lane Departure Warning
cvnaFeatures.description: Lane Departure Warning is a safety feature that automatically alerts you when the vehicle is drifting out of its lane.

cvnaFeatures.name: Heads Up Display
cvnaFeatures.description: Heads Up Display is an advanced feature that projects important information, such as speed or navigation directions, onto the windshield, allowing the driver to keep their eyes on the road.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic Emergency Braking
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic Emergency Braking is a proactive safety feature that uses sensors to detect potential collisions and automatically applies the brakes if the driver doesn't react in time.

cvnaFeatures.name: Active Lane Keep Assistance
cvnaFeatures.description: Active Lane Keep Assistance is an intelligent safety feature that helps keep the vehicle centered in its lane by making subtle steering adjustments, enhancing driver safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Adaptive Cruise Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Adaptive Cruise Control is a smart driving aid that automatically adjusts the vehicle's speed to maintain a safe distance from the vehicles in front, reducing driver fatigue and enhancing safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Parking Assistance
cvnaFeatures.description: Parking Assistance uses sensors to detect nearby obstacles and provides visual or audible feedback to guide the driver and simplify the parking process.

cvnaFeatures.name: Collision Detection
cvnaFeatures.description: Collision Detection is a proactive safety feature that uses sensors to detect potential collisions and alerts the driver to avoid or minimize the impact, enhancing vehicle safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Cross Traffic Alert
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear Cross Traffic Alert is a safety feature that alerts you to vehicles approaching from the side when you're backing out of a parking space or driveway.

cvnaFeatures.name: Alarm System
cvnaFeatures.description: An Alarm System deters theft by sounding an alarm if unauthorized entry is attempted.

cvnaFeatures.name: Driver Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: A Driver Airbag inflates in the event of a collision, providing a cushion to protect the driver from impact.

cvnaFeatures.name: Passenger Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: A Passenger Airbag inflates in the event of a collision, providing a cushion to protect the passenger from impact.

cvnaFeatures.name: Child Seat Anchors
cvnaFeatures.description: Child Seat Anchors provide secure points to attach a child safety seat, enhancing the safety of young passengers.

cvnaFeatures.name: Front Head Curtain Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Front Head Curtain Airbag provides head protection for front seat occupants in the event of a side impact or rollover.

cvnaFeatures.name: Front Side Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Front Side Airbag provides additional protection for the chest and abdomen of front seat occupants in the event of a side impact.

cvnaFeatures.name: Rear Head Curtain Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Rear Head Curtain Airbag provides head protection for rear seat occupants in the event of a side impact or rollover.

cvnaFeatures.name: Driver Knee Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Driver Knee Airbag provides additional protection for the driver's lower body in the event of a collision.

cvnaFeatures.name: Front Knee Airbag
cvnaFeatures.description: Front Knee Airbag provides additional protection for the front passenger's lower body in the event of a collision.

cvnaFeatures.name: Auto Dimming Mirrors
cvnaFeatures.description: Auto Dimming Mirrors are a safety feature that automatically reduces glare by detecting bright lights and dimming accordingly, providing an improved driving experience during night or low-light conditions.

cvnaFeatures.name: Push Button Start
cvnaFeatures.description: Push Button Start allows you to start and stop the engine by pushing a button, as long as the key fob is inside the vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Tilt Wheel
cvnaFeatures.description: Tilt Wheel is a convenience feature that allows the steering wheel's angle to be adjusted, enhancing driver comfort and ensuring a better fit.

cvnaFeatures.name: Heated Steering Wheel
cvnaFeatures.description: Heated Steering Wheel is a comfort feature that warms the steering wheel, providing a more comfortable driving experience in cold weather.

cvnaFeatures.name: Heated Mirrors
cvnaFeatures.description: Heated Mirrors use built-in heating elements to quickly defrost or demist the vehicle's side mirrors, ensuring optimal visibility during cold weather or foggy conditions.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Tailgate/Hatch
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Tailgate/Hatch allows you to open and close the vehicle's tailgate or hatch electronically, often via a button on the key fob or inside the vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Mirrors
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Mirrors allow you to adjust the angle and orientation of the side mirrors electronically from inside the vehicle without manual adjustment.

cvnaFeatures.name: Keyless Entry
cvnaFeatures.description: Keyless Entry allows you to unlock your vehicle without using a traditional key, often just by having the key fob in your possession.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic Air Conditioning
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic Air Conditioning offers effortless climate control, adjusting temperature and airflow to maintain your preferred cabin environment.

cvnaFeatures.name: Multi-Zone Climate Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Multi-Zone Climate Control allows individual passengers to set their preferred temperature, ensuring optimal comfort for everyone in the vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic Windshield Wipers
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic Windshield Wipers are a convenience feature that automatically adjusts wiper speed based on the amount of rain detected on the windshield, improving visibility and allowing the driver to focus on the road.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Locks
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Locks are a convenience feature that allows you to lock and unlock all doors with the push of a button.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Windows
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Windows are a convenience feature that allows the driver and passengers to raise and lower the windows with the push of a button.

cvnaFeatures.name: Cruise Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Cruise Control is a driving aid that maintains your car's speed, providing a more relaxed long-distance driving experience.

cvnaFeatures.name: Compass
cvnaFeatures.description: Compass is a feature that displays the vehicle's direction of travel, helping with navigation.

cvnaFeatures.name: Air Conditioning
cvnaFeatures.description: Air Conditioning is a comfort feature that cools the vehicle's interior, improving passenger comfort during warmer weather.

cvnaFeatures.name: Integrated Garage Door Opener
cvnaFeatures.description: Integrated Garage Door Opener is a feature that allows you to open and close your garage door from the comfort of your vehicle.

cvnaFeatures.name: Power Lumbar Support
cvnaFeatures.description: Power Lumbar Support offers adjustable support for the lower back, enhancing seat comfort and reducing fatigue on long drives.

cvnaFeatures.name: 12V Power Outlet
cvnaFeatures.description: 12V Power Outlet provides a convenient power source for charging devices or using other electronic accessories in your car.

cvnaFeatures.name: Alloy Wheels
cvnaFeatures.description: Lightweight alloy wheels improve your car's performance and fuel efficiency, while also enhancing its aesthetics.

cvnaFeatures.name: Tire Pressure Monitor
cvnaFeatures.description: Tire Pressure Monitor is a safety feature that alerts the driver when one or more tires are underinflated, helping to prevent tire-related accidents and improving fuel efficiency.

cvnaFeatures.name: Fog Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: Fog Lights are specially designed lights that provide improved visibility in foggy or misty conditions, enhancing safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Daytime Running Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: Daytime Running Lights automatically switch on when the vehicle is in motion, increasing its visibility to other road users and reducing the likelihood of daytime accidents.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic Headlights
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic Headlights turn on and off based on the surrounding light conditions, enhancing visibility and safety.

cvnaFeatures.name: Automatic High Beams
cvnaFeatures.description: Automatic High Beams is a smart lighting feature that automatically switches between high and low beams depending on the presence of other vehicles, enhancing visibility and reducing the need to manually change light settings while driving at night.

cvnaFeatures.name: LED Headlamps
cvnaFeatures.description: LED Headlamps use energy-efficient LED bulbs to provide bright and clear illumination, improving visibility and safety while driving at night or in low light conditions.

cvnaFeatures.name: LED Tail Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: LED Tail Lights use energy-efficient LED bulbs to provide bright and clear illumination at the rear of the vehicle, improving visibility for drivers behind you.

cvnaFeatures.name: LED Daytime Running Lights
cvnaFeatures.description: LED Daytime Running Lights are energy-efficient, long-lasting lights that automatically illuminate during the day, enhancing visibility and safety for other drivers.

cvnaFeatures.name: Hill Assistance
cvnaFeatures.description: Hill Assistance refers to a range of systems that help maintain control on slopes by preventing rollback on uphill starts, controlling speed when descending, and keeping the vehicle stationary on inclines until acceleration.

cvnaFeatures.name: Stability Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Stability Control is a safety feature that detects and reduces loss of traction, enhancing vehicle stability and safety during cornering or sudden maneuvers.

cvnaFeatures.name: Traction Control
cvnaFeatures.description: Traction Control is a safety feature that prevents wheel spin by automatically reducing engine power or applying brakes to specific wheels, enhancing vehicle stability.

cvnaFeatures.name: Anti-Lock Brakes
cvnaFeatures.description: Anti-Lock Brakes is a braking system that prevents the wheels from locking up during sudden braking, improving control and reducing the risk of skidding.

cvnaFeatures.name: Manual Mode
cvnaFeatures.description: Manual Mode gives the driver the option to manually shift gears in an automatic transmission, offering more control over the vehicle's performance.

cvnaFeatures.name: Paddle Shifters
cvnaFeatures.description: Paddle Shifters allow drivers to manually shift gears in an automatic vehicle, offering more control over the vehicle's performance.

reviews.review_text: Love this car! Has everything I want and more. The technology in the car was a bit overwhelming at first, but now I wonder how I ever drove a car without it! Rides smooth and is a delight to drive!
Very roomy vehicle for my size (6'8") and very conducive to my family needs. Very luxurious, excellent tech. Perfect drivability experience.
Acura RDX 2019 - looks and runs smooth, feels safe and slick interior
Love the car play and display screen. Love sunroof.
I love everything. Sleek and stylish and fun!
The car is comfortable, reliable, fun to drive and looks good; inside and out.  a very good value for the money.
Acura RDX is an excellent vehicle. It drives very smoothly and is excellent for longer road trips. My only complaint is with the infotainment system. It's not intuitive and lacks touch control.
Fun to drive on curves

to get one like mine because is beautiful inside and out.

I just love this car.

cvnaFeatures.name: Bluetooth Music

cvnaFeatures.name: Noise Cancellation

cvnaFeatures.description: Pairs a phone wirelessly for hands-free calls, letting the driver stay connected and keep both hands on the wheel where they belong.

cvnaFeatures.description: Wirelessly mirrors a compatible smartphone's apps and navigation on the vehicle's display, cutting out cables for a cleaner, more seamless connection.

cvnaFeatures.description: Four USB ports distributed through the cabin ensure the driver, passengers and rear occupants can charge and connect devices simultaneously without compromise.

cvnaFeatures.description: Factory-applied deep tint reduces glare and solar heat inside the cabin while giving passengers added privacy from the outside.

cvnaFeatures.description: Quickly clears frost and condensation from the rear glass on cold mornings so the driver always has a clear view behind.

reviews.review_text: Excellent SUV
It's good with lots of room and drives great
Good value for the money
Great value, fuel efficient and safe.
It is a great car, and I love mine.
It's sporty, fast, fuel efficient and affordable
Nice reliable vehicle, very roomy, nice interior.
It's the best SUV I have ever had, good quality car.
Easy to drive, safety features
There are zero air vents for back seat passengers. we live in Nevada and it's HOT! I can't believe there are NO air vents in the back! FAIL!

Great mileage per gallon with surprising power. On-demand AWD is terrific and profile of the vehicle allows for solid transportation in a variety of road and weather conditions. The vehicle sits up higher than expected for a very good view of the surroundings. Engine is a little louder in taking off (it becomes unnoticeable in a short amount of time) but is very quiet (as is the overall ride) on the expressway. The nine-speed transmission is easy and adds to the overall performance of the vehicle. Interior configurations allows me to easily haul around my bike inside the vehicle along with my ride day supplies.
Don't get a black vehicle in Michigan.
Nice ride easy to drive. Safety features are great

you will love the handling

I like the way the vehicle looks and handles. The warning signals are a great feature. I like being able to answer phone calls easily without a phone in hand.
This is a smooth zippy maneuverable quiet car which looks stylish and is still very functional. Broadway to the Beach!

reviews.review_text: This is the third Volkswagen Jetta I have owned. This one being the newest, I can say that I thoroughly enjoy driving Volkswagens and will continue to buy them for the quality, overall handling and performance, and aesthetics.
I loved my vehicle at first but only a couple months after owning it, it started making noises by the rear brake and five lights came up at once on my dashboard.
Great car, love the interior and exterior. Very stylish car with lots of options. Comfortable and smooth ride. Very sporty and fun to drive. Excellent gas mileage!!
great fuel economy

Buyers regret buying a manual transmission. Moved from country to city. Shift shift shift all the time. I hate it. Size is good, mileage is good. Heated seats do not work. Apple CarPlay constantly turns off on me.

Very comfortable sporty fun sedan with space and all the features. Not a fan of the navigation, it uses an app Android Auto on your phone and does not run properly on my phone, so I do not use the gps via my car. Definitely the most annoying part of my car.
Vehicle is economical and low maintenance. The interior is nice and the features on it are up to date. The driving is smooth and sound proof.
I love this car, my only complaints are that the headlights stay on even when they're off & I wish the seats were electric to adjust them.
Jetta is a classic and will not give you much problems

I love the purr the Volkswagens engine offers when accelerating. It feels luxurious, yet reminds the driver of performance. The vehicle is comfortable for long trips both from seat comfortability and space within the car. The trunk size is one of my favorite features. I swear it's an endless possibility what you can fit in there. Pro tip if you leave a scented trash bag in your trunk, you will always get compliments on the vehicles smell when it's opened. I only hate two things about this vehicle. The seats stain easily, even from water. You have to tediously upkeep your seats for them to look clean and fresh. I also hate, living in a small community, that there are few people who understand Volkswagens.
Do not buy the Automatic transmission.

The car has good acceleration and decent handling, it feels good running errands around town or going on deserted roads.  Sport mode is mandatory if you want a fun experience, I advise not even using the drive mode because the transmission feels like it's holding back and sluggish, and the cost savings in gas is minimal. The car's exterior is pretty good, simple but has extra lines where needed to make it look more aggressive.  Interior is much to be desired, interior trim looks cool and sporty but the tech is sad.  The car needs a better interface, both hardware and software need to be updated.  Really need more options in the interface to customize both the interface and your driving experience.  The car has a good sound system though.  The one issue I have with the exterior is the lighting, they should have included full LED lighting. Driving Dynamics/Value score: 7/10 Aesthetics and Interior Experience/Value: 5/10 Final Grade included weights: 7/10 The interior is a little bland and the tech is a little sad but the overall fun factor while driving is amazing.
Drives nice, great features, unbeatable price, good on gas
Comfortable seats spacious trunk

One of the few higher end models with standard transmission available.  Rides well, fairly well put together.  Only minor problems since purchase.  Items that are annoying - automatic mirror useless at dusk/dawn and automatic wipers are not able to be disabled.  NAV is basic and almost useless as it is mostly blocked when you are driving.
Safety features, value, cost to own, power, driveability.
Very nice car.

The car is a lot of fun. It's not super fast but it's very quick and you can beat it around town and have fun while still getting around 20mpgs. The best thing is that it comes pretty much fully loaded with many features, like the amazing Fender audio system. I valet on the side as well as my primary job and I'll park a lot of high end cars. Over 90% of these cars that cost much much more don't have a back up camera that is as good as mine.
This car is a joy to drive. It is spacious and has great trunk space. Seats 4 comfortably.
Don't do it!

reviews.review_text: This is second Fiat 124 that I have owned.  It's a second car for me.  I have owned some type of roadster for over 35 years.  The 124 is my favorite.  It's fun to drive, quick AND fast, looks great, handles great and is very well made.
Absolutely love this vehicle; it is the most fun to drive.
I love my Fiat Spider. It's fun to drive. Putting the top down is so quick and easy. Looks great. People look at it as I drive by.

The 2017 Fiat Spider is a phenomenal car that packs a punch all-around! We were looking for a convertible specifically, something that would replace our motorcycle due to road safety concerns. We did not know much about Fiat but as Jeep owners, we were comfortable with the idea of another Chrysler product. Once we saw what the Fiat offered for our main sticking points, we were virtually sold! We wanted a manual convertible top (as most other convertibles had hydraulic tops & prone to costly failure), something stylish with sleek lines and lovely interior - the Fiat is known for its Italian flair, and a car that was economical as a weekend vehicle mostly. This vehicle checked our boxes and it is a fun drive too! We love it and receive a lot of compliments as we are out and about!
Nice sporty 2 seat convertible. roomy trunk considering it is a convertible.
Great sports car but would be better if it had more POWER, bought it to replace my Porsche 944 turbo.
The most unreliable vehicle I have ever had.

I love the sporty, fun, convertible nature. I hate the fact that 10,000 miles and 5 months in the clutch went out. This should have been vetted. It turns out it wasn't covered under the powertrain warranty and it is costing me an additional $3000 right off the bat. NO HAPPY!
Vehicle performs exactly as it should and as you want it to. Combines style and performance well. You will feel like a million bucks when driving it. Looks like it is a lot more expensive than it is.
My little 2017 Fiat Spider is a hot number! It's quick, cute and stylish. Comfortable with a great sound system, but although I'm 5'8, the big boys don't fit in her comfortably!!
Forget luxury cars wanna be sportscar, they are not. The fiat spider 124 is a sportscar, where you can feel the road and touch the sky.
best vehicle I have ever bought.  I smile every time I drive it and everyone in my family that has driven it, loves it.
A great little affordable sports car.
Don't buy this car! Slow and cheap!
Be 6'-0" or less. Fun to drive!
They need to understand that this is a small care with very little storage space.  It is a sexy car that is fun to drive.
This vehicle is based on proven technology and proven performance. Styling appealed to me because it was more retro. The base vehicle, manufacture has good reputation with this type vehicle
It is a fun great car to drive around town and is always a head turner!
Very happy with all aspects of the car with the exception Nav system. I previously owned a Miata mx-5 and much prefer this vehicle. Only disappointment is lack of android auto integration.
[Name] to drive, great performance and handling, need update to technology

reviews.review_text: Very reliable and styling is good for the price of the car. The car maintains value.
This car is great for someone that wants something somewhat luxurious and good on gas. The car is solid. If you take care of it, it will take care of you.
I love the way the vehicle looks. However, the vehicle is a little smaller than I thought. I find myself hitting my head when getting into the driver seat quite often.
Overall, great car.  I really like the ride, styling, comforts, technology and handling of the car.
Highly recommend! Very comfortable and dependable!
It is a fun car to drive.  It has almost all the options that I want.  I feel safe inside the car.
The car is a dream for me. The look and style of the car as well as all the features I was looking for inside.
The Aspec model handles well but lacks horsepower for a luxury vehicle.
Good car image and good value for the money.

If somebody is looking for a high quality mid-size sedan, they should strongly consider the Acura ILX. A fantastic car with all the economic features of a car with a high end brand quality of an Acura.

What I don't like: Lack of a built in navigation system.  I hate the way the phone has to be hooked up.  I am getting ready to turn in my smart phone for a basic phone so these features won't work anyway.  But I do not like having to hook up the phone.  I find it difficult to use the features and voice recognition never works so I stopped using it. I was helped at the time of buying the vehicle on the functions and also went back for instructions.  I do not like linking a phone to the car. What I do like: The look of the car. I get many compliments on the car.  It drives well and I love the look.  I like the safety features. The only complaint is the features seem to change (and not because of different drivers. This is me driving) such as the door locks. Sometimes they don't lock. I always have to listen to make sure it locks.  It can be very frustrating. I will never buy another car that connects to a smartphone.  I will buy a built in navigation system.

This is a nice reliable car with a sleek interior especially if you are looking for a little bit of luxury. One important missing feature for me is the turn signals that are missing from the ILX.  Most vehicles now include this as a standard feature so I was a bit shocked that it's missing from this model. Overall you do get good value for your money and it's great on gas.
The Siri text feature is very helpful and great for on the go but still using your phone!
I have owned 6 to 7 Acura's over the years. MDX; RDX, RL, TL, ILX - all were great vehicles and worth the money
Well-designed, easy handling, and good on gas

Superior quality, safety, comfort and technology for an affordable price. Many features come as standard equipment in the ILX, whereas other manufacturers you would have to pay for an upgrade and may still not get everything that you want in the vehicle.
The ride is not always comfortable and you feel every bump
Do not buy it. It was poor made. Noises, vibration, mpg is not real.
Safe fun and somewhat sporty little tech car.  Great vehicle 30-60 mph driving and fuel efficiency.
It's a very nice medium sized 4 door sedan with many nice technology options.

reviews.review_text: I was not ready for the level of fuel economy that the car was able to do. I knew that it would be more efficient than my previous 2018 XC60, but being able to do close to 900 miles a tank compared to the 300 miles that my previous XC60 was able to do. I also loved the seamless transition of the electric motor to the ICE powertrain whenever more power was needed. When in power mode, the whole car pulls like a freight train, dashing most sports cars in a sprint to 60 on the highway.
It has great acceleration and handling and is a general pleasure to drive, plus the connectivity features are superb.
Dependability, quality, and style. You can't beat a Volvo.
Please you should get it; it is the safest vehicle on the road.

Love the Volvo that we bought, but I'm not convinced that plug-in hybrid technology is where it needs to be yet. It is recommended that you charge only to 80% so the miles you get on electricity on any vehicle is deceiving. Volvo is not alone in this and they have done a great job with this vehicle, but I might consider gas only next time.
Fantastic car, very safe and great performance. For the money can't be beaten.

The Android Auto Operative System still has some kinks to work out, don't consider this car if you are the type of person who really gets peeved by minor (fleeting) bugs. If you're easy-going it will be a better fit. Otherwise it represents outstanding value in its segment.
Rides and handles beautifully
It is a very comfortable vehicle and has a lot of great features. I think it is very attractive. Gets good gas mileage with the battery.
Go for it! Drives awesome and looks great.
Que no lo haga porque para ser híbrido gasta más gasolina que un auto de gasolina regular.
I love my new car. I would advise anyone to consider buying this car according to their needs. If you have little kids, it is a must to consider their safety and your own.

The "driver assist" features such as brake interventions (while backing up or traveling forward) are very buggy, obtrusive, and can be surprising and jarring for drivers. It can make one afraid of your car's unpredictable behaviors.
Great performance, Looks amazing and very good value
The vehicle seats are very comfortable, the ride is quiet, and you can drive with confidence in safety; it is a luxurious ride without compromising safety. It's a very CAPABLE and pretty ride!
The Volvo has completely exceeded my expectations. It's fun to drive and great to look at.
It's reliable, safe, comfortable. Great value.

Overall the car is terrific. The Volvo app for this model and year is absolutely worthless. All it does is lock and unlock and remote start the vehicle. No travel log, no location info, no information about fuel mileage or distance to empty. All of these were on the app for the 2020 XC40. Very disappointing.
Comfort and safety is important when driving a vehicle. Volvo gives me this everytime I drive my car.
My first tank of gas I got 62mpg. The XC60 Recharge handles great on mountain highways. A joy to drive!

reviews.review_text: Overall, I love my Fiat 500X. I like the unique qualities like the large dashboard that matches the exterior. I wanted something with new technological features, but not anything overly complex. I believe this vehicle is perfect for this. The touch screen is easy to navigate, but offers many features. The Bluetooth is definitely a plus. The vehicle is very roomy and there is a decent amount of storage room (especially in the trunk when you lift up the floor part). The vehicle drives well and accelerates smoothly. MPG is average—nothing impressive. I live in the snow belt and have had no issues driving this vehicle in the snow.

The Fiat 500 X is a small SUV with AWD.  It's both sporty and practical.  It has plenty of cargo space, can seat five, has comfortable seats and lots of air bags.  It handles well and it's fun to drive.  The three drive modes allow for a choice of all weather traction, best gas mileage, or responsiveness.  Stereo has good sound and pairs well with my iPhone.

My Fiat 500 X is great to drive if you want to have fun. It's great for some back roads riding. However, if I could return it I would. The cost of gas was very unexpected. It is my day-to-day car therefore I spend a lot of money on gas. From time to time it has this weird rattling noise in the engine. Aside from that it is a great car, I am just afraid of what could happen and how much money I would have to spend.

The Fiat 500X with the turbo motor and manual transmission is fun to drive and quick. It is also reasonably economical and practical. Unfortunately, this combination of engine and transmission only comes in the base model, so you sacrifice on technology and luxury features.
I love how high end my fiat 500x looks. I love how sporty it sounds when I accelerate. I love my sunroof and moon roof.

If you like to drive, want the comfort of an SUV but something more zippy without being in a sedan and you LOVE low tech cars... this one has everything you need with a little retro feel about the cockpit area - 500X is your car
It is a very fun car to drive and the features are great!

The Fiat 500X is a nice SUV, but a little on the small side. I like the power in the engine and it gets good gas mileage. Three downsides for me with this SUV are:1) it can get really loud inside if you're travelling on the expressway with the windows halfway down or even a little bit cracked2) the window button will sometimes do the opposite of what you want (pulling the button up is supposed to raise the window, but sometimes the window will go down)3) due to the size of the SUV, tall people or wide people will not fit too comfortably in the rear. Overall, it has some nice features and for the price, it's a decent buy.
Fun to drive, good on gas and comfortable

this is a very fun to drive vehicle. offers good fuel economy and fair storage capacity. it does have a view quirks or negative issues, but you will learn to live with them, with the good features overwhelming the bad stuff.

reviews.review_text: Excellent vehicle
Great value compared to other luxury SUVs.

You will love it! Handling, style, performance, comfort - this SUV hits all the marks. We've driven this vehicle in the most demanding traffic on I-5 (the eternal repair of the Tacoma section of freeway) which is a huge bottleneck of entering and exiting traffic that is stop and go - the sensors alert you on 8 lanes of traffic and interchanges seamlessly. The navigation instructs you on even the most recent changes - where you should be in relation to where you want to go. We've taken it on country roads, potholed roads, on the ferry, and even on the beach - this SUV will not disappoint!
The safety of the car it's what we all need.
Very dependable, quality unmatched, fun to drive. It is an experience that has few rivals. Won't be disappointed.

The third row seat comes standard.  If you are a retired couple, this is deadweight that you will lug around for the life of the car and never really use.  It would be nice to have the option of additional storage space in lieu of the 3rd row seat.
I don't like the lack of buttons.  Technology is great but the way it is set up makes it difficult to maneuver the radio and heating/a.c.
It is the safest car in the market.
I love Volvo, I trust in Volvo.
I love it. Great vehicle.
The Volvo is a dream to drive and provides outstanding comfort in driving even for extended periods of driving.
It's great value. The seats are really comfortable. I think it's more comfortable and more fun to drive than an X7.
Excellent Fit and Finish, fuel economy, styling and infotainment system.
Buy it you won't be disappointed.
Durably built. Smart engineering. Feel very safe and confident driving.

Comfortable, sporty for its size, smooth transmission with plenty of pick up and passing power.  Interior is laid out well with lots of versatility in seating.  Plenty of room for family and travel.  Solid vehicle that gives confidence when driving in snow/unfavorable conditions.

The stereo on the regular line is not bueno I found out that they rattle in all of them if you like music! I love music so I like it moderately loud.. but it should not rattle and it rattles on the upgraded Harmon Kardon system. This is on the xc90 my xc60 did not do this it felt solid!
Software issues have been my only complaint. Awesome investment!
DON'T buy the XC90. It's been in for service twice in the 4 months I've owned it. The electronics are all messed up and so far they cannot figure it out.
This is the most comfortable vehicle I have been in.

cvnaFeatures.name: Front Knee Airbag
